jobs.title: Director, Marketing Technology & Campaign Operations
jobs.excerpt: At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change.
jobs.description:
At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.


If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you.


Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a Director, Marketing Technology & Campaign Operations to be a part of making this happen.


About the Role

The Director, Marketing Technology & Campaign Operations owns the technology, data, and operational engine that powers Arctic Wolf’s global marketing organization — from the marketing technology (MarTech) stack and artificial intelligence (AI) roadmap through the campaign operations execution that turns strategy into delivered programs. This role sits on the Growth Services and Operations leadership team and reports directly to the VP, Growth Services and Operations.


This leader owns the marketing technology ecosystem end to end, including Marketo administration, the broader go-to-market (GTM) technology stack, data architecture and governance, and the effort to embed AI into the team’s core workflows. The role also owns the operational engine that delivers campaigns on behalf of the teams that own strategy and pipeline targets, including Acquisition Marketing, Partner Marketing, Customer Marketing, and demand generation. This is a services and execution role for campaigns — it exists so the teams setting demand strategy have one reliable partner who builds, launches, and runs their programs to a high standard, on time, and within budget. Account-based marketing, pipeline acceleration and reengagement, and creative campaign programs sit outside this role's scope and remain owned by other teams.


This leader owns campaign execution across email, webinar, direct mail, and content syndication across the NAM (North America), EMEA (Europe, the Middle East, and Africa), and APAC (Asia-Pacific) regions and Arctic Wolf’s sales plays, including the intake model, service level agreements (SLAs), build and QA standards, and the budget and MDF (market development funds) administration that keep the broader marketing organization moving without becoming a bottleneck.


This is a people-leadership-heavy role, managing a distributed team that spans marketing technology, database management, email and nurture strategy, and campaign operations, and a close partner to the Senior Director, Campaigns and Content and the teams that own demand and pipeline targets.


Responsibilities


Marketing Technology Strategy & Architecture

  • Own the strategy, architecture, and performance of the marketing technology ecosystem, including Marketo administration, governance, and configuration.
  • Build and maintain a rolling 12- to 18-month technology roadmap aligned to company growth goals and GTM strategy.
  • Own vendor selection, contract negotiation, and renewal decisions for MarTech tools, including intent and enrichment platforms, AI data layers, and integration platform as a service (iPaaS) tools.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and vendors and recommend the highest-return investments.
  • Set up, manage, and troubleshoot integrations across the stack, including with Salesforce and other core business systems.

Embedding AI Into Marketing Operations

  • Lead the strategy and execution for embedding AI into the marketing technology stack and daily team workflows.
  • Identify and operationalize AI use cases that make marketers and sales development representatives (SDRs) more effective and efficient.
  • Own measurable outcomes tied to AI adoption, including cycle-time reduction and process automation, and report progress to leadership.
  • Stay ahead of MarTech and AI trends to keep Arctic Wolf’s stack modern and competitive.

Data, Lifecycle & Reporting Infrastructure

  • Own database strategy, lifecycle-stage design, lead scoring, and routing architecture in partnership with the marketing technology and database management team.
  • Own the data and reporting infrastructure that supports campaign attribution, sales-play performance, and pipeline reporting.
  • Establish data governance and compliance practices (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) that maintain accuracy and consistency across marketing systems.
  • Ensure the technology stack is configured for scale, security, compliance, and operational excellence.

Campaign Operations Leadership & Execution Excellence

  • Own the end-to-end campaign operations model across email, webinar (ON24), direct mail (Sendoso), content syndication, and list management, in partnership with the Campaigns and Content team.
  • Own the intake model, SLAs, prioritization, and operating cadence that campaign requests move through, including email rules of engagement.
  • Ensure consistent build quality, tracking, and attribution setup in Marketo and Salesforce across the NAM, EMEA, and APAC regions and sales plays.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to standardize and automate recurring campaign work.

Marketing Investment Planning & Budget Governance

  • Partner with the Revenue and Growth Leadership Team to develop the annual marketing budget, aligning spend with strategic growth priorities and pipeline targets.
  • Implement processes and controls to track, approve, and reconcile spend, ensuring budget discipline, transparency, and alignment with corporate finance practices.
  • Own budget and MDF administration for the team, including AWS Partner Funding requests, claims, and invoicing.

People Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and develop a distributed team spanning marketing technology, database management, email and nurture strategy, and campaign operations.
  • Set clear priorities, SLAs, operating rhythms, and development plans, including a generalist coverage model so aligned stakeholders never lose a point of contact.
  • Build a culture of technical rigor, execution excellence, and continuous improvement.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as the primary execution partner to Acquisition Marketing, Partner Marketing, Customer Marketing, and demand generation for their campaign programs.
  • Serve as the primary marketing partner to Business Applications and IT, resolving dependencies on routing, scoring, and lifecycle triggers.
  • Partner with the Senior Director, Campaigns and Content on campaign calendar, briefs, and content activation.
  • Partner with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, and Finance on shared infrastructure, budget, and vendor decisions.
  • Represent marketing technology and campaign operations priorities in Growth Services and Operations leadership planning.

Who You Are​

  • You are a hands-on technical leader who understands marketing technology architecture at a deep level, and you can run a high-volume campaign execution engine at the same time.
  • You see AI as a practical tool for reducing manual work, not a buzzword, and you can identify where it will actually move the needle.
  • You build scalable processes, SLAs, and governance rather than absorbing chaos into your own schedule.
  • You can manage a distributed, regionally diverse team across both technology and execution disciplines and keep them focused on outcomes, not just tickets.
  • You don’t need to own the pipeline number to care about it — you measure yourself by how well you deliver for the teams who do.
  • You are comfortable owning a roadmap, a budget, and a vendor negotiation, and just as comfortable being hands-on in the platform or the campaign build when needed.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in marketing technology, marketing operations, campaign operations, or demand generation, including 3+ years of people leadership.
  • Hands-on experience with Marketo (or a comparable marketing automation platform) administration and Salesforce.
  • Experience building and owning a marketing technology roadmap, including vendor evaluation, integration management, and stack governance.
  • Experience managing multi-channel campaign execution, such as email, webinar, and direct mail, at scale.
  • Experience identifying and operationalizing AI or automation use cases within marketing or revenue operations workflows.
  • Experience managing distributed or global teams.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect marketing technology and campaign investments to revenue outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in cybersecurity, software as a service (SaaS), or another complex business-to-business (B2B) industry.
  • Experience managing a team spanning multiple regions, such as NAM, EMEA, and APAC.
  • Marketo certification or an equivalent platform certification.
  • Experience with intent or data enrichment tooling, such as 6sense, ZoomInfo, or Clay.
  • Experience administering a marketing budget or MDF program.

Travel Requirements

Typically 10% or less of business travel.


On-Camera Policy

  • To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews.
  • Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers.
  • We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

About Arctic Wolf

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2025), Best Places to Work – USA (2021-2025), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – UK (2024-2026), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024-2026). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.


Our Values 

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion, and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good.


We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here.


We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.


All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including: 

  • Equity for all employees
  • Flexible time off and paid volunteer days
  • 401k match
  • Training and career development programs
  • Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical, mental health, dental, disability, life and AD&D, and value-added services
  • Robust Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with mental health services
  • Fertility support and paid parental leave

Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Arctic Wolf is committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, respectful, and inclusive environment ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. As such, we strive to make our entire experience as accessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for candidates and employees with disabilities and/or other specific needs where possible. Please let us know if you require any accommodation by emailing . View our Hiring Page to learn more about our application process.


Security Requirements

  • Conducts duties and responsibilities in accordance with AWN’s Information Security policies, standards, processes, and controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of AWN business information (in accordance with our employee handbook and corporate policies).
  • Background checks are required for this position.
  • This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”). Please note that, if applicable, an offer for employment will be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export control laws and regulations.

This range reflects the base pay the company reasonably expects to offer for this position, aligned to the broader job family base pay structure. Actual base pay may vary based on skills, experience, and location, including job family level. Liberty University Online (LUO) is seeking dedicated individuals for the roles of Admissions Consultant and Admissions Counselor. As part of our Online Enrollment Team, you’ll have the opportunity to work from home or in our office, engaging with prospective students and guiding them through the enrollment process for a rewarding academic career. As you apply, please note that your application will be considered for both the Admissions Counselor and the Admissions Consultant roles. Our selection process will match your skills and experiences to the position that best aligns with your qualification

Essential Functions and Responsibilities:

  • Convert prospective students into qualified applicants for Liberty University Online programs.
  • Handle a high volume of outbound calls and incoming inquiries regarding graduate and undergraduate programs.
  • Counsel prospective students on program fit, admissions requirements, financial aid processes, transfer guidelines, and military-related issues.
  • Answer complex questions related to the University’s admission policies and procedures.
  • Utilize information management systems to perform contacts and record necessary information.
  • Promote the features and benefits of all undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral programs, emphasizing the value of an online education.
  • Build relationships with support offices to address student concerns and enhance the student experience.
  • Implement daily and weekly feedback from the Management Team to improve processes and exceed departmental key performance indicators.
  • Identify new and innovative ways to enhance recruitment and student services.

Qualifications, Credentials, and Competencies:

  • High school diploma required; customer service or sales experience preferred. A bachelor's degree and previous contact center experience are a plus.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to respond to emails and calls within 24 hours.
  • Ability to work first/second shifts, rotating Saturdays, and occasional overtime.
  • Demonstrated leadership, interpersonal skills, and a commitment to high professional ethical standards in a diverse workplace.
  • Ability to use sound judgment to help students overcome obstacles to their enrollment and degree completion.
  • Regularly required to sit for extended periods for deskwork, as well as stand, walk, and occasionally lift up to 10 pounds.
  • This position requires a reliable internet connection with specific speed and stability requirements. Please note that satellite-based internet providers such as Starlink are not compatible with the needs of this role. We recommend using a wired broadband connection to ensure optimal performance and meet the technical requirements for the position.
  • After the initial 8-10 weeks of training, the 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM shift would be required.

If you are passionate about helping students succeed and are looking to make a meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply!

Full time

Remote Location

Starting rate $17.50

jobs.description:
About Prenosis

Prenosis Inc. is an artificial intelligence company pioneering precision medicine in acute care. Our Immunix™ precision medicine platform drives the development of precision products and enables real-time delivery of optimal therapy. We've created and validated the first FDA-authorized AI biomarker for sepsis, the Sepsis ImmunoScore®.

At Prenosis, we:

  • Put patients first

  • Disrupt with evidence

  • Excel with integrity

  • Go far together

Our staff collectively defined these corporate values to demonstrate how our teams contribute to meaningful and authentic change in U.S. healthcare. We value our diverse talent, strive to foster a culture of continuous learning, and aim to maintain a feeling of belonging and shared sense of purpose.

Prenosis is headquartered in Chicago Illinois and generally operates on Central Time Zone.

Position Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Software/SRE Engineer who spends the majority of their time writing and reviewing production code. You will be a primary technical contributor on the team, designing systems, closing pull requests, debugging production incidents, and setting the technical bar through example. Roughly 80% of your time will be spent on individual technical contribution and architecture; the remaining 20% on the functional management responsibilities that keep a small, high-performing team running smoothly.

You will work across our Go backend services, Python APIs, TypeScript frontend, and Kubernetes infrastructure. Owning full-stack delivery in a HIPAA-regulated environment where correctness and reliability are non-negotiable.

Responsibilities

  • Write production-quality Go and Python backend services: APIs, data pipelines, business logic, and integrations.

  • Build and maintain TypeScript/React frontend features with real attention to UI quality and client-side performance.

  • Conduct deep, substantive code reviews that raise the technical quality of the entire codebase.

  • Drive architectural decision records (ADRs) and hands-on prototypes to validate technical direction before committing the team.

  • Champion HIPAA compliance and security best practices at the code level - in data handling, auth, encryption, and audit logging.

  • Ensure the availability and reliability of applications and systems; proactively identify and address potential failure points before they affect patient-facing workflows.

  • Implement and manage comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting using Prometheus, Kibana, the Elastic Stack, OpenTelemetry, or equivalent tools.

  • Partner with other developers to design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, or equivalent) that streamline development workflows and deployment safety.

  • Drive SDLC improvements: branch strategies, automated testing gates, progressive delivery, and rollback procedures.

  • Embed security and compliance checks into pipelines so HIPAA controls are verified automatically, not manually.

  • Maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS and GCP - ensuring scalability, high availability, and cost efficiency.

  • Manage infrastructure as code using Terraform/Terragrunt; maintain clean, version-controlled, peer-reviewed infrastructure changes.

  • Manage Kubernetes clusters across AWS (EKS) and GCP (GKE); tune resource limits, manage rollouts, and operate services at scale.

  • Implement and maintain deployment tooling - Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, Flux - to optimize workload management and enable GitOps workflows.

  • Debug misbehaving workloads, manage cluster upgrades, and drive operational maturity across the platform.

Expected frequency and duration of travel: 2-3 times a year

Requirements

Qualifications and Experience

Required:

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience with a consistent record of hands-on technical contribution.

  • Expert-level Go and/or Python backend development; you write idiomatic, production-grade code daily.

  • Strong coding skills in Python and similar languages for automation, tooling, and operational scripting.

  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes (EKS, GKE): debugging workloads, tuning resource limits, and managing rollouts. (Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or Flux a plus.)

  • Production TypeScript/React frontend experience - real client-side UI work, not just services

  • Hands-on AWS and GCP experience: maintaining and debugging managed services, networking, and IAM; deploying and operating containerized workloads across both platforms in production.

  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools: Prometheus, Elastic Cloud (or equivalent).

  • Hands-on CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions, GitLab.

  • Hands-on Terraform/Terragrunt experience: maintaining and extending existing infrastructure as code.

  • Strong PostgreSQL skills: schema design, complex query optimization, indexing, partitioning, and migration management.

  • Experience building in a regulated or high-stakes environment where data privacy and auditability matter

  • Analytical problem-solver: you debug and resolve complex, cross-system issues without losing the thread from UI to database to infrastructure.

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Unlimited time off

  • Major opportunity for career development to make significant impact at an exciting growth-stage company

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment

  • Chance to make a real impact on patient care

  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI technology in healthcare

Salary range: $120,000 -$150,000 per year

Prenosis is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Must be eligible to work in the US without sponsorship

The Senior Software Engineer is a hands-on technical leader responsible for sustaining, improving, testing, deploying, and supporting secure, reliable software across the Censis application stack. This role owns complex technical outcomes, influences solution design, raises engineering standards, and mentors other developers. The engineer partners closely with Product, Quality Assurance, Architecture, DevOps, Security, and globally distributed engineering teams to deliver reliable customer value.

Specific Responsibilities

Software Design and Delivery:

  • Own complex maintenance, defect resolution, customer-driven enhancements, and technical work from investigation and design through production support, with clear acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes.
  • Design, develop, and maintain full-stack applications using C#/.NET, Vue.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS, REST APIs, and SQL Server.
  • Make sound design decisions that improve maintainability, extensibility, performance, testability, and reliability without unnecessary complexity.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including solution approaches, API contracts, data flows, operational guidance, and key design decisions.
  • Triage and resolve complex production issues, identify dependencies and risks early, and deliver fixes and small enhancements incrementally within Agile teams.

Quality, Security, and Reliability:

  • Build quality into the development lifecycle through automated unit and integration tests, peer reviews, static analysis, and appropriate end-to-end test support.
  • Apply secure- and privacy-by-design practices, including threat-aware design, secure coding, dependency management, secrets protection, and remediation of identified vulnerabilities.
  • Use only approved development and AI tools and follow applicable Secure Development Lifecycle, data handling, privacy, and compliance requirements.
  • Improve application observability and supportability through meaningful logging, monitoring, diagnostics, and root-cause analysis.
  • Identify recurring defects and support friction, perform root-cause analysis, and implement preventive improvements, reusable patterns, and standard work that reduce repeat incidents and backlog age.

Technical Leadership and Collaboration:

  • Lead technical discussions and code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and help teams converge on practical, supportable solutions.
  • Mentor engineers through pairing, design guidance, review feedback, and knowledge sharing while promoting ownership and independent problem solving.
  • Partner with Product Owners, Support, and QA Engineers to clarify customer impact, refine requirements, define testable outcomes, and surface technical tradeoffs before implementation.
  • Coordinate effectively across Product, Support, QA, DevOps, and Engineering teams, communicate status and risks clearly, and contribute to consistent engineering practices across products.
  • Contribute to architecture, platform, and engineering standards while escalating decisions that require broader alignment.

AI-Enabled Engineering and Continuous Improvement:

  • Use approved generative AI tools to accelerate analysis, coding, testing, documentation, code review, and troubleshooting while maintaining human accountability for quality, security, and correctness.
  • Evaluate AI-generated output for accuracy, licensing, data exposure, security, maintainability, and alignment with coding standards before use.

  • Strong hands-on experience with C#/.NET and modern web development using Vue.js and JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Strong experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs and working with relational databases, preferably SQL Server.
  • Demonstrated ability to write automated tests and use modern engineering practices for code review, version control, build, and deployment workflows.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven mentoring, technical leadership, and ownership without requiring direct people-management responsibility.

The Functional Architect – Workday Student (Australian Higher Education) is the functional leader for student administration engagements across Australian and New Zealand universities. This role is suited to an experienced higher education practitioner with hands-on experience across multiple student administration domains, such as student records, admissions, curriculum and academic structure, advising, student finance and compliance. Technical or systems experience is beneficial but not essential.

What matters most is a genuine interest in understanding how Workday works and the ability to connect platform capability with the realities of university operations. The person who fits this role will be energised by the opportunity to help shape how Workday is applied across the higher education sector.

They serve as the functional leader on Workday Student implementations and are accountable for bringing together the full student lifecycle as it exists in Workday and as it operates within an Australian or New Zealand university. This includes admissions, enrolment, progression, assessment, student finance, graduation and regulatory reporting.

The incumbent is trusted to form a point of view, guide solution direction and make well-informed decisions drawing on their sector knowledge and practitioner experience. Working closely with Engagement Managers, functional leads and senior university stakeholders, they help deliver solutions that are practical, compliant, sustainable and aligned to institutional objectives.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the functional architecture for Workday Student programs from discovery through deployment and stabilisation.
  • Own the end-to-end student lifecycle design, ensuring admissions, student records, curriculum and academic structure, advising, progression, assessment, student financials and graduation operate as one connected solution.
  • Ensure localised solutions are fit for purpose, operationally sustainable and compliant with Australian and New Zealand regulatory obligations, including TCSI, HELP/eCAF, TEQSA, ESOS/CRICOS, PRISMS, admissions pathways, census and EFTSL requirements.
  • Maintain a current understanding of Workday capabilities, releases, AI and agent innovations, translating emerging functionality into practical guidance and roadmap recommendations for universities.

Ben jij een ervaren servicemonteur die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt en collega’s helpt groeien? Zoek je een functie waarin jouw technische vakmanschap direct bijdraagt aan de kwaliteit van zorg? Dan is de rol van Regio Service Coördinator iets voor jou.

Je bent niet alleen technisch specialist, maar ook een coach, sparringpartner en kwaliteitsbewaker. Dankzij jouw kennis blijven zorghulpmiddelen veilig en betrouwbaar in gebruik én help je collega’s om iedere dag het beste uit zichzelf te halen.

Wat ga je doen:

Vanuit huis vertrek je met een goed uitgeruste servicebus naar klanten in jouw regio. Je werkt op locatie bij onze klanten en bent hét aanspreekpunt voor complexe technische vraagstukken. Je neemt collega’s mee in jouw kennis en ervaring, en zet de klant centraal.

Je werkzaamheden zijn:

  • Uitvoeren van onderhoud aan de zorghulpmiddelen, inclusief het oplossen van complexe storingen en het uitvoeren van wettelijke keuringen

  • Zorgdragen voor volledige en correcte registratie van onderhoud, keuringen en storingsoplossingen

  • Initiëren, coördineren en uitvoeren van kwaliteitscontroles om de kwaliteit te waarborgen

  • Coördineren en voorbereiden van onderhoudsprojecten op locatie, samen met collega’s en externe partijen

  • Adviseren en communiceren met klanten over reparaties en technische verbeteringen

  • Begeleiden en coachen van minder ervaren/nieuwe collega’s

  • Signaleren van verbeterkansen en bewaken van kwaliteit, veiligheid en NEN-richtlijnen, beschrijven van processen en zorgen voor een eenduidige werkwijze binnen de teams

Je krijgt veel vrijheid om je werk zelfstandig in te richten en speelt een belangrijke rol in het continu verbeteren van onze dienstverlening.

Requirements

Wat vragen we van jou:

Je bent een ervaren servicemonteur die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt en energie krijgt van het delen van kennis. Je houdt overzicht, werkt nauwkeurig en denkt in oplossingen. Je vindt het leuk om collega’s verder te helpen en weet klanten op een professionele en prettige manier te adviseren. Je voelt je thuis in een dynamische werkomgeving waarin geen dag hetzelfde is en waar flexibiliteit belangrijk is.

Daarnaast:

  • Heb je MBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting elektrotechniek of werktuigbouwkunde

  • Heb je ruime ervaring met het onderhouden en keuren van zorghulpmiddelen

  • Heb je coachende vaardigheden

  • Ben je in het bezit van een rijbewijs B

  • Werk je gemakkelijk met digitale systemen, zoals een iPad

  • Heb je een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal

  • Ben je bereid een VOG aan te vragen

Wat krijg je van ons:

  • Een salaris vanaf €3.500,-, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring

  • Een goede pensioenregeling (50/50)

  • 28 vakantiedagen per jaar

  • Geen onregelmatigheid; dus vrij in de avonden en weekenden

  • Korting op een fitness abonnement; zo zorg je ervoor dat je fysiek in topconditie blijft

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling; maak je ambities kenbaar en wij kijken graag met je mee naar de mogelijkheden

  • Een informele en warme bedrijfscultuur; je komt in een gezellig team van leuke collega’s terecht

  • Een langdurige samenwerking

Heb je interesse?

Solliciteer via onderstaande button en ik neem zo snel mogelijk contact met je op!

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

Heb je nog vragen?

Neem dan contact op met:

Annemarie Tromp (recruiter)

of bel 06-44600908

Maak impact in de zorg met jouw technische expertise én neem collega’s mee in jouw kennis en ervaring!

jobs.description:
• Job Type: Full-time, long-term contractor
  • Workplace: Remote
  • Schedule: Full-time, Monday to Friday - 9:00 am - 6:00 pm EST
  • Compensation: $1,800 - $2,000

About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with meaningful remote opportunities at U.S. and Canadian companies. We build globally distributed teams around people who take ownership, communicate clearly, and deliver at a high standard.

For this opportunity, you will support a direct-to-consumer subscription business where lifecycle marketing plays a central role in customer experience, retention, and long-term revenue.

About the Role

As an Email / Lifecycle Marketing Specialist, you will own hands-on execution across email, SMS, segmentation, retention, deliverability, and reporting. You will personally build and maintain Klaviyo campaigns, automations, and lifecycle flows while managing the connection between Klaviyo and Recharge.

This is an individual contributor role for someone who enjoys being close to the work. You will be expected to understand the strategy behind each campaign, but you will also be the person building, testing, troubleshooting, launching, and optimizing it.

Because the business operates on a subscription model, your work will directly influence churn reduction, repeat purchases, upgrades, winbacks, and customer lifetime value.

Working hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST.

Responsibilities

  • Own and continuously improve the Klaviyo flow architecture across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, winback, and other key lifecycle stages.
  • Build, test, schedule, and launch email campaigns independently while maintaining an accurate campaign calendar.
  • Develop customer segments that enable more relevant messaging, stronger personalization, and better lifecycle performance.
  • Build and execute SMS campaigns and automations as part of an integrated email and retention strategy.
  • Own retention initiatives including churn-save programs, winback campaigns, upgrade offers, subscription messaging, and other customer lifecycle experiments.
  • Manage and troubleshoot the Klaviyo and Recharge integration to ensure subscription and customer data flows accurately between platforms.
  • Monitor email deliverability, list health, sender performance, and engagement signals, and resolve issues before they negatively affect results.
  • Analyze lifecycle performance and translate campaign, flow, and customer data into clear reporting and actionable recommendations.
  • Design and run thoughtful tests across messaging, offers, segmentation, timing, and lifecycle journeys, explaining the rationale behind each test.
  • Troubleshoot execution issues independently using platform documentation, support resources, and AI tools before escalating routine problems.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • 3-6+ years of experience in lifecycle, retention, CRM, or email marketing, with flexibility on exact seniority for candidates with strong hands-on experience.
  • Deep, hands-on Klaviyo experience, including personally building campaigns, automations, flows, segments, and reporting.
  • DTC or e-commerce lifecycle marketing experience.
  • Experience designing and maintaining lifecycle flow architecture rather than only managing or reviewing other people's work.
  • Hands-on experience with customer segmentation, SMS marketing, email deliverability, and list health.
  • Experience executing retention programs such as churn-save initiatives, winbacks, subscription offers, upgrades, or similar lifecycle campaigns.
  • Ability to work independently, troubleshoot problems, follow detailed instructions accurately, and take ownership through completion.
  • Hands-on knowledge of the Klaviyo + Recharge integration and subscription data flows.

Nice to Have:

  • Strong experience with subscription-based e-commerce businesses.
  • Experience creating email assets in Canva, Photoshop, or AI-powered creative tools.
  • Experience developing lifecycle strategy and explaining the reasoning behind campaign, segmentation, testing, and automation decisions.

jobs.title: Klinisch Psycholoog Online - Digitale poli
jobs.excerpt: Online werken als klinisch psycholoog in een team dat digitale zorg niet ziet als noodoplossing, maar als dé manier om het beter, slimmer en mensgerichter te doen.
jobs.description:
Online werken als klinisch psycholoog in een team dat digitale zorg niet ziet als noodoplossing, maar als dé manier om het beter, slimmer en mensgerichter te doen.
Geen wachtkamers of vaste kantoortijden, maar ruimte voor flexibel werken vanuit huis en volledig digitaal, zonder in te leveren op persoonlijk contact of kwaliteit. Bij de Digitale Poli maak je deel uit van een enthousiast team dat werkt aan snelle, doelgerichte zorg met oog voor herstel, veerkracht en zingeving. Je krijgt alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen én om mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van de GGZ.

Wat ga je doen?

Als klinisch psycholoog ben je regiebehandelaar binnen een multidisciplinair online team. Je voert zelfstandig psychotherapie en diagnostiek uit, met aandacht voor complexe problematiek. Je begeleidt basispsychologen en GZ-psychologen in opleiding, en draagt actief bij aan hun professionele groei.

Je werkt vanuit huis, maar staat er niet alleen voor: via dagelijks contact in overleggen en samenwerking binnen behandelingen blijf je verbonden met het team. Daarnaast lever je een inhoudelijke bijdrage aan de ontwikkeling van ons behandelaanbod en een inspirerende leeromgeving. Je taken bestaan onder andere uit: het voeren van intakes, opstellen en evalueren van behandelplannen, systeemgesprekken, deelnemen aan overleggen, uitvoeren van ROM-onderzoek en het ontwikkelen van (groeps)therapieën.

Wat hebben we jou te bieden?

Bij Altrecht heeft je werk betekenis: samen met bevlogen collega’s en een sterk netwerk van zorg- en kennispartners maak je écht verschil in de ggz. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te zijn, mee te denken en te groeien, als professional én als mens.

Je komt te werken in een organisatie vol mogelijkheden, met diverse (TopGGz) specialismen en meerdere werklocaties in en rondom Utrecht. We kijken naar jou als persoon, je ambities en je voorkeuren zoals behandelprogramma’s en woon-werkafstand. Samen vinden we de rol die het beste bij je past.

Daarnaast krijg je van ons:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 6.798,- tot € 9.442,- (FWG 75 in de cao GGZ) op basis van 36 uur per week.

  • Een volledige dertiende maand (8,33% eindejaarsuitkering) en 8,33% vakantiegeld.

  • 166 vakantie-uren en 35 levensfase-uren per jaar (o.b.v. 36 uur per week). Extra tijd voor jezelf? Je kunt tot 36 uur extra verlof bijkopen.

  • Een jaarlijks balansbudget. Je kunt het bedrag uit laten betalen, extra verlof kopen of het bedrag verhogen tot € 1.400,- als je het inzet voor een vrijetijdscursus.

  • Pensioenopbouw bij Pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn, collectieve inkomensverzekering en korting op aanvullende zorgverzekering (IZZ of Zilveren Kruis).

  • Alflex, ons meerkeuzesysteem voor extra arbeidsvoorwaarden. Kies bijv. voor een fiets, sportschoolabonnement of reiskostenvergoeding.

  • Ruimte en mogelijkheden voor (door)groei! Je kunt scholingen volgen bij de Altrecht Academie, deelnemen aan organisatiebrede kennis & expertisenetwerken, meewerken aan onderzoek of jezelf verder ontwikkelen in de praktijk, via opleidingen en intervisie.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een klinisch psycholoog met een nieuwsgierige en innovatieve houding. Je ziet kansen in digitale zorg en durft te pionieren in een dynamisch en veranderend veld. Tegelijkertijd werk je zorgvuldig en zelfstandig, met een scherp oog voor complexe problematiek en het vermogen om regie te houden over behandelingen. Je gelooft in herstelgerichte zorg, werkt vanuit het gedachtegoed van positieve gezondheid en zet digitale middelen doelgericht in om écht van betekenis te zijn voor de cliënt.

Daarnaast ben je een echte teamspeler die collega’s weet te begeleiden en graag bijdraagt aan de ontwikkeling van ons behandelaanbod. Je hebt ervaring met individuele en groepsbehandelingen, blijft rustig in hectiek en schakelt snel wanneer dat nodig is. Je staat stevig in je schoenen, bent BIG-geregistreerd als klinisch psycholoog – of je bent bijna klaar met je opleiding – en je herkent jezelf in onze kernwaarden: passend, vertrouwen, verbindend en (veer)krachtig.

Daarnaast herken jij jezelf in onze kernwaarden: passend, vertrouwen, verbindend en (veer-)krachtig.

Wie zijn wij?

De Digitale Poli is een innovatieve behandelomgeving waar we volledig online zorg bieden aan mensen met angst-, trauma-, stemmings- en persoonlijkheidsproblematiek. Met beeldbellen, chat en interactieve modules bieden we intensieve behandelingen die flexibel én persoonlijk zijn, en altijd afgestemd op de behoefte van de cliënt.

Onze aanpak is gebaseerd op het gedachtegoed van positieve gezondheid: we kijken breder dan klachten en diagnoses en richten ons op veerkracht, zingeving en dagelijks functioneren. Vanuit een transdiagnostische visie werken we evidence-based én mensgericht, in nauwe samenwerking met verschillende afdelingen binnen Altrecht. Zo bieden we snelle, toegankelijke en effectieve zorg, waarbij de eigen regie van de cliënt centraal staat. Als professional krijg je hier de kans om mee te bouwen aan nieuwe digitale behandeltechnieken, onderzoek te doen en zo bij te dragen aan toegankelijke, toekomstbestendige en effectieve ggz – mét behoud van menselijk contact, ook online.

Enthousiast en nu?

Solliciteer eenvoudig via de onderstaande button! Wil je eerst meer weten? Stuur gerust een berichtje of bel met Senada Nikocevic, teammanager, via 06-83110133.

Je bent ook van harte welkom voor een oriënterend gesprek, zodat je de sfeer bij ons kunt ervaren. We kijken ernaar uit om van je te horen!

Goed om te weten

  • Een dagdeel meelopen kan onderdeel uitmaken van de sollicitatieprocedure. Zo leren wij elkaar beter kennen.

  • Acquisitie op basis van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

jobs.description:
Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.

Brown & Brown is seeking a Claims Counsel, Management Liability to join our growing team!

    

The Claims Counsel's primary function is to independently manage a portfolio of complex Management Liability claims, including Directors & Officers Liability, Employment Practices Liability, Fiduciary Liability, Crime, and related financial lines claims involving private companies and nonprofit organizations.


The successful candidate will work closely with underwriting, carrier partners, brokers, insureds, and defense counsel to deliver superior claims outcomes while supporting the strategic growth of Nexus's Management Liability portfolio. This role requires deep technical expertise, sound business judgment, strong relationship management skills, and the ability to balance legal, coverage, financial, customer service, and portfolio considerations in claims decision-making.

How You Will Contribute:  

Claims Management and Coverage Analysis

  • Independently manage a portfolio of complex and high-severity Management Liability claims.
  • Analyze policy coverage and prepare reservation of rights letters, coverage position letters, and declination letters.
  • Conduct detailed factual, legal, financial, and coverage analyses to evaluate liability, damages, and exposure.
  • Establish and maintain appropriate claim reserves within delegated authority and seek additional authority when required.
  • Evaluate settlement opportunities and participate in mediations, settlement conferences, and other dispute resolution proceedings.
  • Exercise sound judgment on complex coverage and litigation issues while maintaining consistency with claims handling guidelines and business objectives.

Litigation Management

  • Direct litigation involving insured organizations and individual directors, officers, trustees, and executives.
  • Retain, manage, and evaluate defense counsel and coverage counsel.
  • Review and approve litigation budgets, monitor legal spend, and negotiate alternative fee arrangements when appropriate.
  • Develop and implement effective litigation and resolution strategies.

Portfolio and Business Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to underwriting regarding claims trends, emerging risks, coverage issues, and portfolio performance.
  • Partner with underwriting teams to identify opportunities for product enhancement and improved risk selection.
  • Analyze claims trends and portfolio data to identify emerging exposures and provide actionable business insights.
  • Prepare timely, accurate reporting for carrier partners and reinsurers and participate in stewardship discussions and portfolio reviews.
  • Demonstrate a balanced approach that considers legal exposure, coverage intent, customer experience, broker relationships, and portfolio impact when making claims decisions.

Broker and Market Engagement

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with retail and wholesale brokers, insureds, carrier partners, and defense counsel.
  • Participate in broker stewardship meetings, claim reviews, underwriting roundtables, and market-facing presentations as needed.
  • Represent Nexus professionally in interactions with brokers, insureds, carrier partners, counsel, and industry stakeholders.

Leadership and Operational Excellence

  • Serve as a technical resource and mentor to less experienced claims professionals.
  • Participate in claims audits, quality reviews, training initiatives, and process improvement projects.
  • Support strategic initiatives designed to enhance claims operations and service delivery.
  • Embrace claims technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency, consistency, and claim outcomes.
  • Ensure compliance with delegated authority agreements, carrier guidelines, service standards, and applicable regulations.

Skills & Experience to be Successful: 

  • Juris Doctor (JD) degree and active bar membership.
  • Minimum 7-10 years of experience handling Management Liability claims.
  • Demonstrated expertise in private company D&O, nonprofit organization liability, EPL, and Fiduciary Liability coverage analysis.
  • Significant experience drafting complex reservation of rights letters, coverage position letters, and declination letters.
  • Significant experience handling shareholder and ownership disputes involving closely held entities; governance and executive liability disputes; regulatory and governmental investigations; and bankruptcy, insolvency, trustee, receiver, creditor, and related executive liability claims.
  • Strong understanding of Management Liability policy forms, endorsements, and coverage structures.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage high-severity and complex claims.
  • Strong analytical, negotiation, litigation management, financial analysis, and relationship management skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Strong business and strategic decision-making capabilities.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and claims management systems.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a small, collaborative, high-performing team consistent with company values.

Preferred

  • Experience handling claims involving private equity-backed, venture-backed, founder-led, or closely held organizations.
  • Experience within an MGA, specialty insurer, E&S carrier, or Management Liability insurance carrier.
  • Experience operating under delegated claims authority.
  • Experience presenting claims trends, portfolio analytics, and emerging risks to senior management, underwriters, brokers, and carrier partners.
  • CPCU, RPLU, SCLA, ARC, or similar industry designation.

$150,000 - $160,000 Annual

jobs.description:
Top Reasons To Join Us

  • Working for the Insurtech Market Leader.
  • 100% Remote
  • Working with cutting edge technologies (Kubernetes, Terraform, GraphQL etc.) and multiple Cloud providers (AWS/Azure/GCP).

About Us

At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.

  • We are a leading global no-code insurance platform for health, life, and P&C.
  • We’re the winner of the Insurtech of the Year in all of Asia and other awards globally.
  • We work with insurance enterprise clients such as AXA, Bupa, MSIG, Dai-ichi, Bank of China Group Insurance, and many more.
  • We're an international, diverse team of over 120 people with 30 nationalities and team members working remotely from all over the world.
  • We are fully funded and backed by reputable VC funds and strategic institutional investors.
  • We have a global presence in Asia, EMEA and the Americas.
  • We’ve grown our annualized revenue by over 30x since January 2021.
  • We’re constantly working towards making CoverGo a workplace that you love coming to. We deeply believe that bringing together a diversity of thoughts, expressions, and perspectives is key to building the best culture for equally diverse communities all over the world.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer with a strong focus on Support & Observability to join our global engineering support team. This role is ideal for engineers who are passionate about solving complex technical problems, improving system reliability, and delivering exceptional customer experiences.

You’ll be part of the frontline technical team—working directly with customers, troubleshooting and resolving platform issues, and collaborating with engineering teams to improve our systems, tools, and processes. While this is a support-heavy role, solid software engineering skills and strong observability knowledge are essential.

About Support Team

Our Support Team acts as the first line of technical assistance for our customers and internal stakeholders. We not only resolve technical issues but also focus on advocating for customers, enhancing support tools, improving documentation, and collaborating closely with engineering teams to elevate the overall experience.

The team works closely with product and project engineering teams to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale, ensuring that solutions are not only reactive but also continuously improved for long-term impact.

What You Will Do

  • Triage and troubleshoot support issues, when required escalate to project or product engineering teams.
  • Analyze system behavior using observability tools—logs, metrics, tracing—to diagnose root causes of incidents in distributed systems.
  • Debug application code (primarily in .NET or NodeJS) and, when required, contribute fixes or code-level solutions.
  • Take ownership of technical issues by directly investigating and resolving problems at the code level, including identifying root causes and implementing fixes when necessary.
  • Work closely with our technical stack (AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Dapr, Terraform, Temporal, Mongo Atlas, PostgreSQL) and our platform languages (.NET, NodeJS, Java).
  • Configure enterprise monitoring solutions.
  • Conduct thorough post-incident reviews to identify root causes and implement preventive measures.
  • Automate support needs, develop runbooks, improve and maintain support tools.
  • Participate in infrastructure capacity planning, demand forecasting, software performance analysis and systems tuning.
  • Understand our product offerings and continuously look for ways to improve the engineering support experience and platform engineering tooling.
  • Participate in R&D / explorations / automation with AI.
  • Help define and drive adoption of KPIs such as CSAT, NPS, resolution time, and first contact resolution.
  • Participate in strategic discussions around customer lifecycle, retention, and satisfaction.

What We Need

  • At least 6 years of experience in support or full stack engineering with a strong focus on delivery, observability, and cloud technologies.
  • Strong hands-on experience in software development with modern technologies such as .NET,Node.js and React or Vue.js.
  • Proven experience leading a squad/team, coordinating team members, driving delivery, and providing technical guidance and mentorship.
  • Distributed Systems Troubleshooting: Proven track record of diagnosing and resolving complex issues in distributed systems.
  • Observability and Monitoring Tools: Experience in utilizing observability platforms for metrics, logs, and tracing to pinpoint root causes in microservice architectures.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and ability to take ownership of customer issues through to resolution.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to build rapport with customers and collaborate effectively with internal teams.
  • Fluent in English.
  • A customer-first mindset—empathetic, responsive, and solutions-driven.
  • A humble attitude, an eagerness to help others, and a desire to pick up whatever knowledge you're missing to make both your team and our customers succeed.
  • Being adept at frequent context switching and working on multiple projects at once with expansive ownership, and ruthlessly prioritize.

You might thrive in this role if

  • You prefer short projects where you can go deep and chase a problem down vs. building long-term solutions over many months. You enjoy seeing multiple use cases, understanding the broad landscape, all while going deep on specific issues.
  • You have previous experience in the insurance or InsurTech space.
  • You are proficient with customer support platforms (e.g., Jira, Zendesk).
  • You have proven track record of leading and scaling customer service operations in a fast-paced environment.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • International Environment
  • Competitive remuneration package
  • Fully Remote
  • Annual Leave
  • Annual Performance Bonus
  • Stock Options after 6 months
  • Health Insurance
  • Remote Work Allowance
  • Company activities and events
  • Learning and development plan

jobs.description:
We're looking for a TikTok Shop and E-Commerce Manager to own and scale the TikTok Shop presence and broader e-commerce ecosystem for a fast-growing better-for-you snack brand. You will manage TikTok Shop end to end, run creator and affiliate programs with a direct focus on revenue, launch and optimize paid ads across multiple platforms, and expand what works on TikTok into Shopify, Amazon, Walmart, Faire, and other wholesale channels.

This is a senior, execution-focused role. You must come in as a TikTok expert with a proven track record of driving revenue through TikTok Shop. This is not a role for someone learning TikTok on the job. If you have built TikTok Shop into a meaningful revenue channel before, understand the full stack from creator strategy to paid ads to listing optimization, and can operate without established processes, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US business hours
  • Own the full TikTok Shop and e-commerce function for a growing CPG brand with real retail traction
  • High-ownership role with direct accountability for revenue performance across multiple channels

What You'll Work On

TikTok Shop Ownership

  • Own TikTok Shop end to end including product listings, pricing, promotions, storefront management, and creator strategy
  • Drive revenue through both organic content and paid ads on TikTok
  • Manage and scale the creator and affiliate program with a clear focus on sales output, not just content volume
  • Expand successful TikTok strategies into other e-commerce channels as they are proven

Paid Advertising

  • Launch, manage, and optimize paid advertising across TikTok, Amazon, Walmart Marketplace, Google Ads, and other relevant channels
  • Monitor and improve key performance metrics including ROAS, CAC, conversion rate, and AOV
  • Make fast, data-driven decisions and iterate quickly based on performance

Multi-Channel E-Commerce Management

  • Manage and optimize product listings across Shopify, Amazon, Walmart, Faire, and other wholesale platforms for conversion and discoverability
  • Identify opportunities for bundling, merchandising, and pricing optimization across channels
  • Manage inventory flow across channels to prevent stockouts and overages
  • Expand learnings from TikTok into the broader e-commerce stack

Reporting and Performance Analysis

  • Analyze performance data across all channels and provide clear, actionable recommendations
  • Maintain consistent reporting with insights that directly inform decisions and improve results
  • Track and report on conversion rates, ROAS, CAC, AOV, and channel-level revenue contribution

What You Bring

  • Proven track record managing TikTok Shop with measurable, attributable revenue results
  • Deep expertise in TikTok including content strategy, creator management, affiliate programs, and paid ads
  • Hands-on experience scaling TikTok Shop from early stage to meaningful revenue
  • Experience managing at least one additional platform such as Amazon, Walmart Marketplace, or Shopify
  • Strong performance marketing background with direct experience running and optimizing paid ads
  • Data-driven with the ability to make fast decisions and iterate without waiting for perfect information
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment without established processes
  • Strong ownership mentality with full accountability for results

Nice to Have

  • Experience in CPG, food and beverage, or better-for-you consumer brands
  • Familiarity with Faire or wholesale e-commerce platforms
  • Background managing Amazon Seller Central or Walmart Seller Center independently
  • Experience building creator or affiliate programs from scratch rather than inheriting existing relationships

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A portfolio link or examples showing TikTok Shop results you have driven including revenue impact, ROAS improvements, or creator program outcomes
  3. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, walking through a TikTok Shop you have managed, and describing the strategy behind your creator or affiliate program and the results it produced

Only candidates who submit both examples and a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you have built TikTok Shop into a real revenue channel before, know how to scale creator and affiliate programs that actually sell, and want to own e-commerce growth for a brand with strong product-market fit, this role gives you the ownership and the direct impact to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.

We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

jobs.title: Director of Solution Architecture
jobs.excerpt: At Journal Technologies, we believe our technology can be a force for good in the world ensuring the proper and efficient functioning of some of the most foundational aspects of society - the courts and justice system.
jobs.description:
At Journal Technologies, we believe our technology can be a force for good in the world ensuring the proper and efficient functioning of some of the most foundational aspects of society - the courts and justice system.

We create and implement enterprise software that supports the administration of justice, currently in the United States, Canada, and Australia. While our eSeries product suite enables governments and their employees to deliver continued foundational court processes, our R&D focuses on leveraging emerging possibilities with technology to improve access and efficiency.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, Journal Technologies is a long-time, wholly-owned subsidiary of Daily Journal Corporation (NASDAQ: DJCO). We also have a major office in Logan, Utah, a team in Melbourne, Australia, an office in Victoria, Canada and a growing number of remote staff across North America.

Under our next generation of leadership, we're implementing a new vision for the company that prioritizes building an extraordinary workplace with empowered people at the heart of our business. Great people want to collaborate with great people, and we are actively looking for smart, motivated people who care deeply about the work they do.

Director of Solutions Architecture

Journal Technologies is seeking an experienced technical and justice-domain leader to establish and lead the Configuration Center of Excellence (CCoE).

The CCoE will define how Journal Technologies designs, configures, validates, and maintains customer solutions across the eSeries platform. The Director will establish configuration architecture, standards, technical governance, implementation patterns, training, and quality controls that improve system performance, reduce implementation risk, and create greater consistency across customer implementations.

This position requires extensive hands-on knowledge of software applications and a strong understanding of how justice agencies operate. The Director must understand both the technical capabilities of the platform and the business processes the platform supports, including case initiation, case processing, calendaring, hearings, financials, document management, disposition, reporting, interfaces, and downstream justice-partner exchanges.

The Director will serve as a senior technical authority for configuration practices across Journal Technologies and will work closely with Professional Services, Product Management, Engineering, Support, Cloud Operations, and the PMO.

The CCoE will support lifecycle and implementation teams by providing standards, architecture, technical leadership, training, and escalation support. Lifecycle teams remain accountable for delivery.

Core Responsibilities

Configuration Architecture and Standards

  • Establish and lead Journal Technologies’ Configuration Center of Excellence.
  • Define configuration architecture, engineering standards, and implementation methodologies for eSeries.
  • Establish clear standards for business rules, workflows, events, conditions, validations, system properties, forms, templates, financial configuration, security, interfaces, and other configurable platform components.
  • Define appropriate use of configuration, scripting, integration, and product functionality.
  • Establish patterns that prevent unnecessary customization and configuration technical debt.
  • Develop reference configurations, reusable patterns, templates, and implementation accelerators.
  • Establish configuration naming, documentation, versioning, promotion, and change-management standards.
  • Define standards for configuration performance, maintainability, supportability, and upgrade compatibility.

Technical Governance and Quality

  • The Director owns JTI’s enterprise configuration standards. CCoE standards apply across Professional Services and lifecycle teams unless an exception is approved through the established governance process. The Director has authority to require technical review and remediation of material configuration risks and to escalate unresolved readiness concerns before production deployment. Lifecycle leaders retain accountability for project delivery, customer commitments, staffing, schedules and budgets.
  • Establish technical review processes for complex or high-risk configuration.
  • Define configuration quality gates for implementation milestones, testing, production readiness, and go-live.
  • Establish standards for reviewing business rules, queries, integrations, workflows, and other configuration that can affect application performance or system stability.
  • Develop methods for identifying configuration related performance and scalability risks before Production deployment.
  • Partner with Cloud Operations, Engineering, and Support to analyze configuration-related incidents and convert lessons learned into improved standards.
  • Establish measurable configuration quality and adoption metrics.
  • Experience working within Agile teams or formal training in Scrum or Agile methodologies is considered a strong asset.

eSeries Technical Leadership

  • Serve as a senior technical authority for eSeries configuration across the various business units. 
  • Provide guidance to implementation teams on complex configuration and solution design decisions.
  • Assist teams with difficult configuration, performance, integration, and implementation issues.
  • Identify configurations that should use existing product capabilities instead of custom development.
  • Identify recurring customer requirements that should become standard product capabilities.
  • Maintain reference architectures for common court and justice-system implementation patterns.
  • Ensure configuration approaches account for application architecture, database performance, integration requirements, security, cloud deployment, and operational support. The above statements describe the general nature and level of work being performed in this job function. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties; additional responsibilities may be assigned.

Justice Domain Leadership

  • Ensure configuration standards reflect the operational requirements of courts and justice agencies.
  • Apply knowledge of justice system models when developing implementation standards.
  • Help implementation teams understand the business and operational consequences of configuration decisions.
  • Establish reusable implementation patterns for common processes and justice-system integrations.

Product and Engineering Partnership

  • Establish a structured feedback loop between implementation teams, Product Management, and Engineering.
  • Identify recurring implementation challenges caused by product gaps or configuration complexity.
  • Recommend product changes that reduce implementation effort and eliminate unnecessary custom configuration.
  • Work with Product Management to distinguish customer-specific requirements from capabilities that should become part of the standard product.
  • Provide field-based technical input into product architecture and roadmap discussions.
  • Evaluate new product capabilities and determine how configuration standards and implementation practices should change as the platforms evolve.

Technical Community and Capability

  • Lead the JTI Technical Lead Community across Implementation Specialists, Data Integration Developers, Solution Leads, and other technical delivery roles.
  • Establish competency expectations for technical implementation roles.
  • Develop structured technical onboarding and continuing education for eSeries.
  • Establish configuration certification or proficiency programs.
  • Conduct technical workshops, architecture reviews, configuration reviews, and mentoring sessions.
  • Build and maintain configuration playbooks, reference implementations, examples, and technical documentation.
  • Develop senior technical resources who can act as configuration authorities within lifecycle teams.

Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze implementation, Support, Production, and upgrade issues to identify recurring configuration problems.
  • Measure adoption of CCoE standards and identify areas requiring additional training or governance.
  • Reduce configuration complexity and technical debt across implementations.
  • Develop automation and tooling for configuration analysis, validation, migration, comparison, and quality assurance.
  • Use implementation experience to improve JTI’s implementation methodology and product capabilities.

Required Qualifications

  • Extensive hands-on experience implementing, configuring, supporting, integrated web-based software applications.
  • Deep understanding of the software architecture, including business rules, workflows, conditions, validations, system properties, forms, templates, API integrations, security, and related configuration components.
  • Significant experience designing and troubleshooting complex configurations.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into scalable and supportable application configurations.
  • Experience diagnosing configuration-related application performance and stability issues.
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, database queries, transactions, application performance, and enterprise application architecture.
  • Strong working knowledge of SQL, REST APIs, web services and enterprise application architecture, with demonstrated ability to understand and evaluate Java, Groovy and Velocity-based platform components.
  • Experience leading technical teams, technical communities, architecture initiatives, or enterprise implementation standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor technical staff and communicate complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • 10+ years of enterprise justice-system software implementation, configuration, architecture, or technical delivery experience, including significant experience with Journal Technologies products.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Extensive hands-on experience implementing, configuring, supporting, Journal Technologies eSeries applications.
  • Deep understanding of the eSeries configuration architecture, including business rules, workflows, conditions, validations, system properties, forms, templates, integrations, security, and related configuration components.
  • Extensive experience working within the justice industry, with a strong understanding of how the various justice agencies interact.
  • Experience with justice system integrations, data exchanges, and interface architecture.
  • Experience implementing multiple jurisdictions.
  • Experience with large-scale implementations and Production go-lives.
  • Experience with justice-based data conversion and justice-system interfaces.
  • Knowledge of NIEM and other justice information exchange standards.
  • Experience with cloud-hosted enterprise applications and SaaS delivery models.
  • Experience developing configuration governance, technical standards, or implementation methodologies.
  • Experience working directly with Product Management and Engineering to convert implementation requirements into product capabilities.
  • 10+ years of enterprise justice-system software implementation, configuration, architecture, or technical delivery experience, including significant experience with Journal Technologies products.

At this time, we are only able to consider candidates who are Canadian or U.S. citizens or permanent residents due to employment authorization requirements. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or work authorization support for this position.

Why Journal Technologies?

Visit for more information, but highlights include:

Final compensation will be based on job-related factors, including qualifications, experience, geographic location, and internal compensation considerations.

We provide technology that matters in the world, and we're a stable employer comprised of quality people, with a commitment to investing in our people.
