Position: Senior Editor, Analytics

Position Type: Full-time, Permanent (Existing Vacancy)

Location: Remote within Canada The Company: Postmedia is a Canadian news media company representing more than 110 brands across multiple print, online and mobile platforms. Award-winning journalists and innovative product development teams bring engaging content to millions of people every week whenever and wherever they want it. This exceptional content, reach and scope offers advertisers and marketers compelling solutions to effectively reach target audiences. We are always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our team.

The Opportunity:

Postmedia is looking for a Senior Editor, Analytics to join the National Product and Strategy team. A senior editor within the National Product and Strategy team is a newsroom leader who partners with multiple editorial teams across the company to elevate journalism, strengthen content strategy, and support transformative initiatives. Our Senior Editor, Analytics will translate audience data, market insights, and analytics into actionable editorial recommendations and work with newsroom leaders to build a data culture.

This role blends editorial expertise, strategic thinking, and data-informed decision-making. You’ll work closely with editors, reporters, product teams, and audience specialists to help newsrooms develop and achieve their goals. This is an ideal role for an experienced editor who excels at collaborative problem solving, thrives in complex environments, and can guide diverse teams through both quick-turn and long-term initiatives.

Act as the primary point of contact between our analytics department and newsrooms. Advocate for data-driven approaches to inform story decisions, improve page views and grow reader engagement. Work with newsroom leaders to develop a data culture; help make journalists aware of the value of data and how it can support their work. Develop and lead workshops on how to use data to make decisions. Help set key performance indicators. Build and monitor reports with KPIs and results. Analyze audience data, identify trends, and provide timely recommendations that contribute to informed journalistic decisions. Write clear and concise memos and strategic briefs on data-informed opportunities for newsrooms.

Who you are:

You have a minimum of five years of newsroom experience, with knowledge of analytics and audience strategy. You are confident in your abilities to dig deep into the numbers - you thrive in a world of spreadsheets. You understand how to use data to troubleshoot or highlight new opportunities. jobs.description:
About us

mazeed is a financial management platform that helps businesses automate accounting, simplify tax compliance, and stay ready for e-invoicing through a combination of localized software (SaaS) and Finance-as-a-Service (FaaS). We work with SMEs and growing companies across the GCC, enabling them to operate with clarity, control, and confidence.

We are building the infrastructure for the next phase of financial compliance and digital transformation in the region, with a strong focus on e-invoicing and scalable financial operations

Job Purpose

The ERP Success Lead is responsible for leading, coaching, and supporting the ERP Success function while also managing key enterprise accounts. In addition to overseeing complex onboarding, data migration, and technical support activities, this role provides subject matter expertise across ERP processes and implementations.

You remain hands-on, ensuring high-quality onboarding delivery, providing advanced technical support for complex cases, and acting as the escalation point for critical customer issues by diagnosing challenges and driving effective solutions. This role also plays an active part in the presales process by attending strategic sales demos, supporting the commercial team with ERP expertise, validating customer requirements, and advising on technical feasibility and solution design.

The ERP Success Lead plays a critical role in maximizing client value from the mazeed platform by combining strong financial acumen, deep technical knowledge, and leadership capabilities. The role works closely with Product, Sales, and Support teams to improve processes, support product feedback loops, and ensure the highest standards of delivery and team performance.

Primary Responsibilities

ERP Team Support

  • Support the ERP Success team in successful implementation SLA achievements, including daily operations, task allocation, and performance monitoring and client engagement

Client Onboarding & Data Migration

  • Lead and manage client onboarding, ensuring smooth setup, accurate configuration, and successful data migration of client accounts.

  • Prepare solution design documentation, a process map and implementation plans.

  • Attend Presales activities and manage any customization request

Financial Analysis & Advisory

  • Utilize financial expertise to understand each client’s business and financial model, goals, and challenges, providing tailored insights and recommendations.

Client Success & Partnership

  • Serve as a financial advisor and success partner, guiding clients on best practices to ensure long-term satisfaction and retention.

Implementation & Process Optimization

  • Translate financial data and client workflows into actionable implementation plans that align with business objectives.

  • Support knowledge sharing within the team and contribute to internal documentation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with product, operations, and support teams to ensure seamless execution and alignment on client needs.

  • Join the commercial team to identify client needs and deliver tailored product demos based on the industry and business model.

Performance Monitoring & Retention

  • Monitor account performance, adoption, and financial outcomes to drive retention, engagement, and satisfaction.

Risk Identification & Problem Solving

  • Identify risks or areas for improvement and proactively offer effective, data-driven solutions.

Support & Issue Resolution

  • Manage and follow up on client support tickets, ensuring first call/chat resolution and clear communication between clients and internal departments.

  • Act as the voice of the customer—bring real-world insights to help shape roadmap and feature delivery.

Presales Support

  • Attend sales demos as the ERP subject matter expert to support the commercial team.

  • Analyze client business needs in real time during demos and translate them into ERP use cases.

  • Handle customer functional and technical questions to live during sales meetings and demos.

  • Assess and validate customer customization requests and advise on feasibility, effort, and product fit.

  • Support solution positioning by mapping customer requirements to Mazeed ERP modules and features.

  • Document presales findings and requirements to ensure smooth handover to onboarding and implementation teams.

Core Values

Being a mazeeder, our promise to customers, internal teams, HR and Leadership is to demonstrate our core values in our daily interactions and quality of work:

  1. Integrity

  2. Customer Obsession

  3. Simplicity

  4. Growth Mindset

  5. Innovation

  6. Empowerment

Role: HR Coordinator

Location: United States or Canada (Remote/Hybrid)

Client: Andromeda Software, Inc. (a Constellation Software Inc. operating group)

ABOUT ANDROMEDA:

Andromeda Software is an operating group of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU). Andromeda’s promise — “Permanent Home. Powered by People.” — captures how we operate: we acquire vertical market software companies with the intent to hold them permanently, and we invest deliberately in the leaders and teams who build them. The Andromeda portfolio includes 30+ companies, 22+ offices, and 2,500+ employees across North America, Europe, Latin America, and Asia, drawing on 100+ industry-leading tools and best practices shared across the network. CSI — one of the world’s largest acquirers of vertical market software, with 1,100+ businesses across nine operating groups — provides the scale and capital that lets Andromeda focus on long-term ownership rather than short-term exits. We think in decades, not quarters. Andromeda’s headquarters is in Markham, Ontario, Canada.

ROLE SUMMARY:

The HR Coordinator is the first call for HR administration at the Andromeda Home Office. Working as part of the Home Office HR team, the HR Coordinator keeps the people-operations basics running smoothly: accurate employee records in Workday, well-run onboarding and offboarding, clean hiring paperwork, and dependable coordination with our US and Canadian payroll partners.

Andromeda is deliberately decentralized. Business Unit HR Generalists own day-to-day HR within each business, while the Home Office HR team builds the policies, tools, and programs they operate within. The HR Coordinator supports that model by handling the administrative work behind it carefully and consistently, so that BU leaders and Home Office colleagues can rely on the HR function to be accurate, responsive, and discreet.

This is an excellent role for an early-career HR professional who wants broad exposure across HR operations, including HRIS, onboarding, recruitment support, payroll coordination, and HR communications, and who takes pride in owning their work end-to-end. Andromeda invests in its people for the long term, and this role offers a real path to grow within the HR function.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

1.HR Administration & HRIS (Workday):

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for the Andromeda Home Office team on HR administrative requests, responding promptly and following each request through to completion.
  • Perform general maintenance and administration of the Workday HRIS, including data entry, record updates, and routine transactions.
  • Ensure electronic employee files in the HRIS are complete, accurate, and well organized.
  • Maintain new hire and termination checklists so that every step is completed and documented.
  • Handle employee and candidate information with discretion, in line with Andromeda policy and applicable US and Canadian privacy requirements.

2.Onboarding & Offboarding:

  • Manage onboarding and orientation for new hires in designated business units, giving each new colleague a clear, welcoming start.
  • Coordinate IT requirements for new hires (equipment, accounts, and access) with the relevant IT contacts ahead of start dates.
  • Coordinate the background check process for candidates in the US and Canada, tracking each check to completion.
  • Complete USCIS Form I-9 accurately for US new hires as part of onboarding, ensuring it is completed within the federal deadline of three business days after the first day of employment.
  • Support the offboarding process by completing termination checklist items and keeping records current.
  • Assist with drafting and sending termination documentation as part of offboarding, under HR guidance and with appropriate review and approval.

3.Recruitment Support & Employment Documentation:

  • Support the HR team with general recruitment activities and coordination, as required.
  • Assist with creating job descriptions and job requisitions.
  • Generate offer letters and provide candidates with the necessary documentation.
  • Draft employment change letters and respond to related calls and inquiries when needed.

4.Payroll Partnership & Reporting:

  • Partner with the HR and Payroll teams in Canada and the US to ensure timesheets are completed and vacation records are reviewed.
  • Support other analytical and reconciliation procedures by checking data, flagging discrepancies early, and helping resolve them.
  • Process one-time payments and compensation-related changes in Workday for Payroll, ensuring accurate entries and timely submission in line with required approvals and payroll deadlines.

5.Communications, Stakeholders & Projects:

  • Assist in creating and editing HR content for communications, orientation materials, and presentations.
  • Build strong working relationships with internal clients and key stakeholders, and represent Andromeda well in every interaction.
  • Assist HR management with special projects and process improvements as needed.
  • Assist HRGs, HRBPs, HMs with administrative HR tasks or provide basic coverage as needed.

CORE COMPETENCIES:

Intellectual Humility — Curiosity: Keeps developing their HR craft, asks good questions about the “why” behind processes, welcomes feedback as input, and is comfortable saying “I’m not sure, let me find out.”

Owner Mindset — Accountability: Owns their work end-to-end and sees commitments through. Notices what needs doing without being asked, treats confidential information and company resources with care, and finds a way forward when blocked.

Collaborative Problem Solving — Teamwork: Brings solutions, not just problems. Communicates clearly and often with HR, Payroll, IT, and BU colleagues, asks for help early, and looks for small ways to improve how the team works.

Drives Results & Operations —Metrics & Efficiency: Delivers consistently and on time, with accuracy in records, letters, and checklists. Focuses on what matters most, reduces rework, and becomes the person colleagues trust to get things done without follow-up.

Stakeholder Engagement— Influence & Connection:Builds good working relationships with Home Office and BU colleagues, tailors communication to the audience, checks what people actually need before assuming, and represents Andromeda well with candidates and new hires.

Strategy — Vision & Planning: Understands how HR operations support the Home Office and the Business Units. Plans and sequences their own work well, prioritizes the highest-impact items, and speaks up when they see a better way.

Team Leadership—Talent & Culture: Leads by example through professionalism, follow-through, and a positive attitude. Helps newer teammates learn, offers honest feedback kindly, and recognizes that culture is built by everyone.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • College diploma or university degree, ideally in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Equivalent practical experience will be considered.

Experience

  • 1–3 years of related HR or administrative work experience, preferably in a North American environment
  • Experience with Workday is highly preferred.
  • Exposure to US and/or Canadian employment practices, onboarding, I-9s, and background check processes is an asset.
  • Skills & Attributes
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills (Word, Excel, Outlook, SharePoint, PowerPoint).
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a high standard of accuracy.
  • Highly developed interpersonal skills and clear written and verbal communication.
  • Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential employee information.
  • Flexibility and the ability to adapt to change.
  • A strong sense of ownership, creativity, and self-motivation, with a habit of proactively seeking feedback and new work.
  • Authorization to work in the United States

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE UNIQUE:

The HR Coordinator is a place to do high-quality, owned work in a company that invests in its people for the long term.

Because the role touches onboarding, HRIS, recruitment support, payroll coordination, and HR communications across both the US and Canada, it offers unusually broad exposure to how a growing, multi-business HR function really works.

Andromeda’s culture is decentralized: close to the business, low on bureaucracy, and focused on enabling the people doing the work.

The HR Coordinator will see the impact of their work quickly, and the right candidate, curious, dependable, and eager to take on more, will find real room to grow within Andromeda’s HR function over time.

jobs.excerpt: Du kennst DATEV aus dem Arbeitsalltag und erklärst gerne Dinge, bis sie wirklich sitzen?
jobs.description:
Du kennst DATEV aus dem Arbeitsalltag und erklärst gerne Dinge, bis sie wirklich sitzen? Dann suchen wir dich - deutschlandweit, komplett im Homeoffice, in Voll- oder Teilzeit.

Wir sind die Digitalagentur1 und begleiten Steuerkanzleien in ganz Deutschland bei der Digitalisierung. Unsere Kunden sind ausschließlich Steuerberater. Deren Mandanten betreuen wir nicht selbst, aber wir machen die Kanzlei fit darin, ihre Mandanten sicher zu begleiten.

Zu wem passt diese Position?

Du musst kein Steuerfachangestellter sein. Vielleicht kommst du aus einer Steuerkanzlei - oder du hast in einem Unternehmen gearbeitet, das mit DATEV arbeitet. Beides passt. Zu uns passen zum Beispiel Steuerfachangestellte, Finanzbuchhalter, Lohnbuchhalter, Bilanzbuchhalter oder Mitarbeiter aus der Kanzlei-Eigenorganisation.

Unsere Themen

  • DATEV Rechnungswesen

  • DATEV Personalwirtschaft (LODAS und Lohn und Gehalt)

  • Kanzlei-Eigenorganisation

  • DATEV Cloud – zum Beispiel DATEV Unternehmen online, DATEV Personal oder DATEV Meine Steuern

Genau dort tauchen im Kanzleialltag Fragen auf: Wie stellen wir einen Mandanten auf DATEV Unternehmen online um? Warum zieht die Buchung nicht sauber durch? Wie richten wir einen neuen Mandanten in der Personalwirtschaft ein? Du bist die Person, die diese Fragen beantwortet.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Support: Du beantwortest DATEV-Rückfragen aus den Kanzleien - per Telefon, Videocall und per Fernwartung direkt am Bildschirm.

  • Schulung: Du zeigst Kanzleiteams in Online-Schulungen, wie sie mit DATEV effizienter arbeiten.

  • Beratung: Du begleitest Kanzleien bei Umstellungen, zum Beispiel auf digitale Belege, DATEV Unternehmen online oder neue Abläufe im Rechnungswesen und in der Personalwirtschaft.

  • Prozesse und Checklisten: Du hilfst uns, unsere internen Abläufe und Checklisten weiterzuentwickeln, damit jeder Vorgang nach demselben klaren Standard läuft.

  • Schulungsakademie: Du baust unsere interne Schulungsakademie mit aus - Unterlagen, Leitfäden und Lerninhalte, von denen das ganze Team profitiert.

Keine Sorge: Wir schulen dich komplett ein.

Du bekommst eine vollständige Einarbeitung in alle Themen, mit denen du zu tun hast. Wir gehen alles gemeinsam durch, üben es mit dir und lassen dich erst dann eigenständig arbeiten, wenn du dich sicher fühlst. Du musst also nicht alles schon können.

So arbeitest du bei uns

  • 100 % Homeoffice, deutschlandweit: Du brauchst nicht umzuziehen und nicht zu pendeln.

  • Feste Kernzeiten: Montag bis Donnerstag ab 8:30 Uhr, mindestens 5,5 Stunden am Tag - so sind wir für die Kanzleien verlässlich erreichbar.

  • Voll- oder Teilzeit: Der Mindestumfang liegt bei 22 Stunden pro Woche, Vollzeit sind 40 Stunden.

  • Alles digital: Termine, Schulungen und Support laufen online, keine Reisetätigkeit.

  • Klare Abläufe: Feste Prozesse statt Improvisation - du weißt jeden Tag, woran du bist.

Wir bieten

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen.

  • Tolle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Der Umgang untereinander ist sehr kollegial und familiär. Wir ziehen alle am gleichen Strang und motivieren uns gegenseitig, Bestleistungen zu erzielen und persönlich zu wachsen.

  • Volle Einarbeitung: Wir schulen dich in allen Themen ein und üben alles mit dir.

  • Moderne Technik und laufende Weiterbildung, damit du fachlich am Ball bleibst.

  • Gute Vergütung & Karrierechancen: Unsere Mitarbeiter erhalten Weihnachtsgeld sowie vermögenswirksame Leistungen. Über die nächsten Jahre werden wir weiter wachsen und expandieren. Dazu benötigen wir weitere Experten und/oder Führungskräfte.

Zwei wichtige Hinweise

Die Tätigkeit ist ausschließlich aus Deutschland oder dem europäischen Ausland möglich. Und weil bei uns alles online läuft, brauchst du zu Hause eine stabile Internetleitung.

Noch mehr über uns

Wenn du weitere Informationen zu unserem Unternehmen und deiner Karriere bei Digitalagentur1 haben möchtest, findest du diese auf .

Auf unserem YouTube-Kanal erhältst du persönliche Einblicke in den Arbeitsalltag bei Digitalagentur1 - authentisch, direkt und auf Augenhöhe: .

Requirements

Das ist bei uns Voraussetzung

Du hast bereits mit mindestens einem dieser DATEV-Programme gearbeitet:

  • DATEV Rechnungswesen oder

  • DATEV Personalwirtschaft - also LODAS oder Lohn und Gehalt

Eines von beiden solltest du aus der Praxis kennen. Alles Weitere bringen wir dir bei.

Das solltest du außerdem mitbringen

  • Du erklärst gerne und hast Geduld, auch wenn du dieselbe Frage zum dritten Mal beantwortest.

  • Du arbeitest sorgfältig, verbindlich und hältst dich an vereinbarte Abläufe.

  • Du bist sicher am Rechner und findest dich in neuer Software schnell zurecht.

  • Du kommunizierst freundlich und klar - am Telefon genauso wie schriftlich.

  • Du arbeitest im Homeoffice selbstständig und zuverlässig und hast eine stabile Internetleitung.

Du hast bisher nur in einem Bereich gearbeitet?

Kein Problem. Ob Rechnungswesen oder Personalwirtschaft - den Rest bringen wir dir bei. Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung in einem bestimmten Beruf ist keine Voraussetzung, deine Erfahrung zählt mehr als dein Abschluss.

Du möchtest dein DATEV-Wissen weitergeben, statt es jeden Monat für dieselben Mandanten anzuwenden? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Highlights

100 % Homeoffice – deutschlandweit, ohne Reisetätigkeit

Attraktive Vergütung – faires Festgehalt nach Erfahrung

Volle Einarbeitung – ein Bereich reicht zum Start

jobs.description:
Customer Service Representative

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S Business Hours

About the Role

We’re looking for a friendly, organized, and customer-focused Customer Service Representative to support customers throughout their post-purchase experience, from production and shipping to delivery and installation.

You’ll serve as the main point of contact for customer inquiries, providing timely updates, answering product and installation questions, coordinating with internal teams and shipping providers, and resolving order-related issues. The ideal candidate combines excellent communication skills with strong follow-through and a commitment to delivering a positive customer experience.

What You’ll Own

Customer Communication & Order Updates

  • Keep customers informed about production progress, shipment tracking, delivery schedules, and installation instructions.
  • Monitor shipments and notify customers on the expected delivery date.
  • Respond to customer inquiries promptly and professionally.
  • Follow up proactively to ensure customers know what to expect at every stage.

Product Support & Installation Assistance

  • Answer product and installation questions using available resources and approved guidance.
  • Help troubleshoot installation issues and coordinate with technical staff when additional support is needed.
  • Explain instructions clearly and help customers understand the next steps.

Customer Issue Resolution

  • Handle reports of damaged shipments by gathering photos, details, and relevant order information.
  • Coordinate claims, replacement parts, and other resolutions with the appropriate teams and providers.
  • Respond to frustrated customers calmly and professionally, focusing on practical solutions.
  • Track outstanding issues and follow through until they are resolved.

Order Coordination & Recordkeeping

  • Maintain accurate customer records, order details, shipment information, and communication history.
  • Follow established procedures and ensure important details are documented.
  • Coordinate with sales representatives, manufacturers, shipping providers, and technical staff.
  • Keep all parties informed to help prevent delays and ensure a smooth customer experience.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Excellent spoken and written English.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills, with a warm and patient approach.
  • Familiarity with construction, home remodeling, installation, or related terminology.
  • Excellent organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.
  • Ability to follow established procedures while recognizing when an issue needs escalation.
  • Comfort learning product details and explaining instructions to customers.
  • Familiarity with customer management systems, email, and spreadsheets.
  • Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace suitable for customer calls.
  • Ability to work consistently from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting customers in shades, windows, home improvement, or building products.
  • Experience with shipping, logistics, order tracking, or fulfillment coordination.
  • Experience handling damaged deliveries, replacement requests, or shipping claims.
  • Experience coordinating between customers, vendors, and technical teams.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You communicate clearly and make customers feel supported, even when problems arise.
  • You take ownership of customer requests and follow through without needing repeated reminders.
  • You stay organized while managing multiple inquiries, orders, and delivery timelines.
  • You remain calm and solution-oriented when dealing with delays, complaints, or unexpected issues.
  • You know when to resolve a problem independently and when to involve the appropriate team.
  • You are proactive about updates and understand the importance of keeping customers informed.

What Success Looks Like

  • Customers receive timely, accurate updates throughout the production and delivery process.
  • Delivery expectations and installation instructions are communicated clearly.
  • Customer issues are documented, escalated when necessary, and followed through to resolution.
  • Internal teams and external partners stay aligned on outstanding orders and customer needs.
  • Customers experience a smooth, organized, and professional support experience.

Interview Process

  • Initial Screening
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and confident Intake Coordinator to manage incoming enquiries, support the client intake process and help convert prospective clients into active customers.

This role combines strong administrative coordination with client communication and sales. The successful candidate will be responsible for responding to enquiries, gathering information, guiding prospective clients through the intake process and ensuring consistent follow-up to keep opportunities moving forward.

We are open to candidates with previous sales experience, but this is not essential. A strong administrator with excellent communication skills, confidence on the phone and the ability to take initiative could be an excellent fit.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

1. Client Enquiries & Communication

  • Respond promptly and professionally to incoming enquiries from prospective clients.
  • Contact prospective clients by phone, email and other communication channels.
  • Build rapport and establish trust with prospective clients.
  • Understand client needs, answer questions and provide clear information about available services.
  • Ensure all communication is professional, friendly and easy to understand.

2. Intake Coordination & Administration

  • Guide prospective clients through the intake and onboarding process.
  • Collect, review and accurately record required client information.
  • Manage intake documentation, forms and administrative records.
  • Ensure all required information is received and outstanding items are followed up.
  • Coordinate appointments, next steps and relevant communication.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in the relevant systems.
  • Manage multiple enquiries and administrative tasks efficiently.

3. Sales & Lead Conversion

  • Take ownership of incoming leads and ensure timely follow-up.
  • Engage prospective clients and understand their needs.
  • Confidently explain services and guide clients towards the next step.
  • Handle questions, concerns and objections professionally.
  • Use persuasive, relationship-focused communication to encourage prospective clients to move forward.
  • Follow up consistently with interested leads to improve conversion rates.
  • Identify opportunities to move enquiries through the intake process and successfully convert them into clients.

4. General Administrative Support

  • Provide day-to-day administrative support related to client intake and coordination.
  • Keep trackers, records and systems updated.
  • Monitor outstanding tasks and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
  • Identify administrative bottlenecks and take initiative to resolve them.
  • Support additional operational tasks as required.

Minimum Requirements

  • Previous experience in administration, client coordination, customer service, sales or a similar role.
  • Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.
  • Clear, confident and easily understood verbal communication.
  • Strong organisational and administrative abilities.
  • Excellent attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Confident telephone manner and ability to engage professionally with clients.
  • Strong initiative and willingness to take ownership of responsibilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong computer literacy and ability to learn new systems quickly.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.

Advantageous Experience

  • Previous sales, telesales or lead-conversion experience.
  • Experience in client intake, onboarding or customer coordination.
  • Healthcare, medical administration or patient intake experience.
  • Experience managing incoming enquiries and following up with prospective clients.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, ATS platforms or client management software.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is smart, quick-thinking, hardworking and naturally takes initiative.

The ideal candidate should be:

  • An excellent communicator: Well-spoken, articulate and confident when speaking with clients.
  • Proactive: Takes ownership, initiates follow-ups and doesn't wait to be reminded about tasks.
  • Highly organised: Fast and efficient with administrative work while maintaining accuracy.
  • Persuasive: Comfortable building relationships, handling objections and encouraging prospective clients to move forward.
  • Diligent: Reliable, hardworking and committed to completing tasks properly.
  • Quick to learn: Able to pick up new systems, processes and responsibilities quickly.
  • Results-driven: Understands the importance of timely responses, consistent follow-up and successful lead conversion.

Important: Sales experience is a strong advantage, but not a deal-breaker. We are equally open to an excellent administrator with outstanding communication skills, confidence and the ability to take initiative. The ability to communicate clearly and be easily understood over the phone is essential.

About Kinaxis

Elevate your career journey by embracing a new challenge with Kinaxis. We are experts in tech, but it’s really our people who give us passion to always seek ways to do things better. As such, we’re serious about your career growth and professional development, because People matter at Kinaxis.   

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, with a brand-new HQ based in Kanata North in Ottawa. As one of Canada’s Top Employers, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

At Kinaxis, we power the world’s supply chains to help preserve the planet’s resources and enrich the human experience. As a global leader in end-to-end supply chain management, we enable supply chain excellence for all industries, with more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries. We are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in Canada, Mexico or the US

About the team

We are embedding AI directly into how we implement, assure and support Maestro, and we are growing our Professional Services AI Development capability. As an AI Solutions Engineer, you will work side by side with consultants, Solution Architects and subject-matter experts to find high-value Maestro and delivery problems, build AI-enabled solutions quickly, and scale the ones that work across our global Professional Services organization.

This is a hands-on, field-embedded engineering role. You will take problems from observation through prototype, production, adoption and measurable impact. This is not a data science or AI strategy role.

What you will do

  • Build AI solutions for Professional Services: design, prototype and productionize AI agents, automations and reusable components for implementation quality and knowledge, blueprinting and configuration, risk identification, UAT planning, documentation, integration, data readiness and validation and solution performance diagnostics.

  • Engineer production-quality applications: build agent orchestration, retrieval and grounding, API and enterprise integrations, evaluation and regression testing, observability, security and release management.

  • Create reusable patterns: contribute to a common PS AI development foundation, including agent patterns, connectors, evaluation frameworks, development standards, CI/CD and implementation playbooks.

  • Measure business impact: work with PS project manager and leadership to baseline and track time to value, configuration effort, PS hours per deployment, rework, adoption, AI operating cost and customer outcomes.

What we are looking for

  • Strong Python development experience

  • Hands-on experience building applications with large language models, including agentic workflows and orchestration

  • Retrieval, grounding and context engineering techniques

  • Azure or comparable enterprise cloud engineering, plus API and enterprise integration experience

  • Git and modern CI/CD practices

  • Experience evaluating and testing probabilistic AI systems

  • Working knowledge of authentication, authorization and enterprise security fundamentals

  • Practical experience with several of: Azure OpenAI / Microsoft Foundry, Claude / Claude Code, the Microsoft Copilot ecosystem, tool/function calling, RAG, structured outputs and human-in-the-loop workflows

Nice to have

  • Experience in enterprise software implementation, supply-chain technology, professional services, solution architecture, enterprise SaaS or business-process automation

  • Kinaxis Maestro experience is a plus but not required. We value a strong applied-AI engineer who can learn Professional Services and Maestro quickly.

Who you are

  • Builder-oriented: you prefer shipping working solutions to producing strategy decks

  • Field-oriented: you are comfortable observing consultants and customers to find the real problem

  • AI-native and pragmatic: you build in evaluation, feedback loops and guardrails, and know when conventional software is the better answer

  • Product-minded and collaborative: you turn one-off solutions into reusable capabilities and work with experts rather than replacing them

  • Outcome-driven: you measure success by customer quality, delivery speed and efficiency

What success looks like

In your first 90 days, you will learn the delivery lifecycle and current AI architecture, become productive in our common development environment, and take at least one use case from problem definition to a working prototype with a measurable baseline. Within 6 to 12 months, you will own several production AI capabilities, contribute reusable components used across multiple agents, and help scale proven solutions across regions and delivery teams.

Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day—when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Yamaha, P&G, Honda, and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis: Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. jobs.description:
gestalte mit uns die energiewende

Wir von TESVOLT Energy machen es für Betreiber kleiner und mittlerer Batteriespeicher erstmals möglich, lukrativ am Flexibilitätshandel teilzunehmen. Bisher hatten sie keine Chance, einen guten Trader zu finden, der ihre kleineren Speicherkapazitäten an der Energiebörse handelt. Wir bringen sie gebündelt als virtuelles Kraftwerk ans Netz – gehandelt durch die besten Trader am Markt.

Unsere Arbeit ist technisch anspruchsvoll, datenbasiert und nah an der Praxis. Genau das begeistert unser Team: ein Umfeld, in dem Analyst:innen, Entwickler:innen und Strateg:innen gemeinsam etwas bewegen können.

Du denkst Infrastruktur nicht nur mit, sondern voraus? Du willst Systeme bauen, die stabil, sicher und skalierbar sind – und gleichzeitig Entwicklerteams empowern? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

Diese Stelle kannst du remote bei uns ausführen.

deine aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt unser Marketing bei der Planung, Umsetzung und Nachbereitung von Kampagnen und bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Kommunikationsmaßnahmen ein.
  • Du erstellst und pflegst Content für unsere Website, LinkedIn und weitere Kommunikationskanäle und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Themen verständlich, professionell und zielgruppengerecht aufbereitet werden.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Präsentationen, Broschüren, Grafiken und weiteren Marketingmaterialien und achtest dabei auf eine saubere Umsetzung unseres Corporate Designs.
  • Du wirkst bei der Organisation und Durchführung von Messen, Veranstaltungen und vertriebsnahen Kommunikationsformaten mit.
  • Du wertest Marketing Kennzahlen aus, bereitest Ergebnisse übersichtlich auf und hilfst dabei, unsere Aktivitäten datenbasiert weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du unterstützt den Vertrieb bei der Erstellung von Erlösberechnungen und Wirtschaftlichkeitsbetrachtungen für Batteriespeicherprojekte.
  • Du bereitest Kundendaten, Projektinformationen sowie Angebots- und Präsentationsunterlagen strukturiert für Vertrieb, Partner und Management auf.
  • Du pflegst CRM und Kundendaten zuverlässig und stellst sicher, dass relevante Informationen sauber dokumentiert und für das Team nutzbar sind.
  • Du bekommst einen umfassenden Einblick in Marketing und Sales eines innovativen Unternehmens der Energiewirtschaft, von Website Texten und LinkedIn Beiträgen über Kampagnen bis hin zu konkreten Vertriebsprojekten.

dein profil

  • Du absolvierst ein Studium im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation, Wirtschaft, Energiewirtschaft oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.
  • Du interessierst dich für erneuerbare Energien, Batteriespeicher, Energiehandel und die Frage, wie wirtschaftlich tragfähige Lösungen die Energiewende voranbringen können.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und zuverlässig und hast Freude daran, Themen sauber aufzubereiten und sichtbar voranzubringen.
  • Du verfügst zwingend über gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens B1/B2) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse und kannst Inhalte klar, präzise und adressatengerecht formulieren.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Microsoft Office, insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel.
  • Erste Erfahrungen in der Erstellung von Marketing-Content, Präsentationen oder Social Media Beiträgen sind von Vorteil.
  • Ein gutes Gespür für Gestaltung, visuelle Kommunikation und saubere Unterlagen ist wünschenswert.
  • Du hast Lust auf die hands-on Mentalität eines jungen Start-ups und schätzt gleichzeitig die Zugehörigkeit zu einer etablierten Unternehmensgruppe

warum wir?

Wir sind ein Team aus Batteriespeicher-, Daten- und Energiemarktexpert:innen, die vorher teils bei
TESVOLT und teils in der Energie-Praxis bei anderen Scale-Ups, einschlägigen Beratungen und
Energieversorgern gearbeitet haben und bringen Know-how zu Batteriespeichern und

Energiehandel aus erster Hand mit.

Uns verbindet die Überzeugung, dass wirtschaftlich tragfähiger Klimaschutz möglich ist – mit
klugen Ideen, starken Partnern und einem besonderen Team.

  • Du erhältst Einblicke in die Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft, des Energiehandels und der Flexibilitätsvermarktung von Batteriespeichern.
  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, nah an echten Projekten und mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Du arbeitest direkt mit Marketing, Vertrieb und Management zusammen und bekommst dadurch einen breiten Blick auf ein wachsendes Geschäftsmodell.
  • Dich erwartet ein motiviertes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, hoher fachlicher Nähe und der gemeinsamen Überzeugung, dass wirtschaftlich sinnvoller Klimaschutz möglich ist.
  • Du profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, arbeitest überwiegend mobil und hast mit unserem Berliner Office einen gemeinsamen Anlaufpunkt für persönlichen Austausch.

jobs.excerpt: Career-defining.  Life-changing.  At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world.
jobs.description:
Career-defining. Life-changing.

At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career

About This Role:

Manager, Customer Care Training & Delivery

About This Role

The Manager, Customer Care Training leads the Customer Care training function, including new hire onboarding, ongoing learning, training content, readiness support, and adoption of approved learning technologies. This role is accountable for ensuring training programs prepare employees to perform effectively in a high-volume, regulated, and digitally evolving Customer Care environment.

This role manages Training & Development Specialists and partners closely with Customer Care Operations, Quality, Workforce Management, Support Readiness, Compliance, and other business partners to plan, deliver, and continuously improve onboarding, continuing education, systems training, AI-enabled learning initiatives, and change-readiness support.

The Manager ensures training is consistent, current, measurable, and aligned to operational priorities, quality expectations, compliance requirements, and employee readiness needs. The role uses training data, learner feedback, quality trends, operational metrics, and stakeholder input to identify gaps, recommend solutions, and support responsible adoption of approved AI tools and learning technologies.

What You'll Be Doing

Training strategy, delivery and operations

  • Lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of Customer Care onboarding, role-based training, continuing education, systems training, refresher training, and change-readiness learning programs.
  • Manage training schedules, facilitator assignments, learner communications, classroom or virtual learning logistics, and team coverage to meet operational needs.
  • Ensure training programs are delivered consistently, reflect established curriculum and procedures, and remain aligned to business requirements, quality standards, compliance expectations, and approved operational changes.
  • Support updates to training materials based on changes to processes, systems, products, policies, and procedures.
  • Partner with stakeholders, subject matter experts, and business partners to obtain information needed to maintain accurate training content.
  • Review participant and stakeholder feedback to recommend improvements to training materials and delivery on a regular basis.
  • Facilitate training or provide coverage as needed.
  • Use approved AI and digital learning tools to improve content development, learner engagement, knowledge reinforcement, and scalable training delivery.
  • Support evaluation, implementation, and adoption of approved AI-enabled learning solutions in partnership with business, compliance, privacy, and technology stakeholders.

Employee readiness, performance and training effectiveness

  • Monitor learner attendance, completion, assessment results, proficiency progress, quality trends, and readiness indicators across assigned training programs.
  • Coordinate knowledge checks, assessments, practice activities, and other established methods for evaluating learner readiness.
  • Partner with Customer Care Operations, Quality, Workforce Management, and Support Readiness to identify recurring knowledge, skill, process, or adoption gaps and translate them into training reinforcement plans.
  • Provide coaching and feedback to trainers regarding facilitation and training delivery.
  • Track established training metrics, summarize trends, and provide regular updates, insights, and recommended actions to Customer Care leadership.
  • Identify trends or recurring training needs and recommend appropriate follow-up actions.
  • Support employees as they transition from training to production by coordinating reinforcement, coaching support, job aids, and readiness feedback loops with Operations and Quality.
  • Use training data, learning analytics, operational feedback, and approved AI-generated insights to identify knowledge gaps, readiness risks, and development opportunities.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of AI-enabled learning solutions and recommend improvements to support employee proficiency and performance.

Learning support for business change and transformation

  • Develop and coordinate training plans for new or updated processes, systems, products, policies, procedures, workflow changes, and technology-enabled ways of working.
  • Partner with business leaders and subject matter experts to understand upcoming changes, assess learner impact, define training needs, and align timelines for readiness support.
  • Ensure impacted training materials are updated and communicated to trainers and learners.
  • Support adoption of new tools, processes, and workflows through training, job aids, coaching resources, reinforcement activities, and stakeholder feedback loops.
  • Gather employee and trainer feedback following changes and escalate recurring issues or training needs as appropriate.
  • Support training initiatives related to automation, AI-enabled business tools, digital channels, knowledge management, and other technology changes that affect Customer Care operations.
  • Assist employees in adopting new digital and AI-enabled solutions through training, coaching, job aids, and reinforcement activities.

Compliance & Quality

  • Ensure training is delivered in accordance with established company policies, procedures, quality requirements, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain training documentation and records in accordance with established requirements.
  • Coordinate required reviews and approvals of training materials.
  • Partner with Quality, Compliance, Privacy, and other appropriate functions to address training-related requirements.
  • Reinforce expectations related to quality, documentation, privacy, customer support standards, and escalation procedures.
  • Support training-related activities associated with audits or inspections as needed.
  • Support the responsible and compliant use of approved AI tools within training programs and learning content development.

People leadership and team management

  • Manage, coach, and develop Training & Development Specialists, setting clear expectations and supporting strong performance, accountability, engagement, and continuous growth.
  • Establish team priorities, assign work, monitor progress, remove barriers, and ensure training deliverables are completed in alignment with business needs.
  • Manage training schedules and team coverage to support operational needs.
  • Provide regular feedback, coaching, and performance management for direct reports.
  • Support development of trainer capabilities in facilitation, instructional delivery, learning technology, and training content development.
  • Support the development of trainer capabilities related to AI tools, digital learning technologies, and emerging learning practices.
  • Promote teamwork, accountability, continuous improvement, and a strong customer focus.
  • Escalate resource, performance, or operational issues to management as appropriate.

About You

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in training, learning and development, customer care operations, or a related field.
  • 1+ year of experience leading, supervising, coaching, or training.
  • Experience delivering or supporting training programs in an operational environment such as Customer Care, contact centers, patient support, healthcare operations, or a similar service environment.
  • Working knowledge of adult learning principles, facilitation, coaching, and training assessment methods.
  • Experience developing or updating training materials, job aids, or other learning resources.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple training activities, schedules, and priorities.
  • Ability to use training results, employee feedback, and operational information to identify training needs and recommend improvements.
  • Experience utilizing technology-enabled learning solutions, training platforms, or digital tools to support employee development and performance improvement.
  • Ability to analyze performance and training data to identify trends and recommend learning solutions.
  • Strong communication, organization, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience using learning management systems, training technologies, or similar tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, medical device, life sciences, or another regulated industry.
  • Experience supporting training within a contact center or customer support environment.
  • Experience supporting remote or geographically distributed employees.
  • Experience with scenario-based or proficiency-based training and assessment.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, contact center technologies, knowledge management platforms, or digital learning tools.
  • Experience leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to support training delivery, content development, knowledge management, coaching, or employee enablement.
  • Experience implementing or supporting AI-enabled learning technologies, digital adoption platforms, or workforce development solutions.
  • Familiarity with Generative AI tools and their application within learning and development environments.

BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000+ real devices and browsers.

With over 1,200 employees and a remote-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.

Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.

jobs.excerpt: If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you!
jobs.description:
If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Job Description Summary

Are you a problem solver who can analyze complex risk and find insurance solutions that balance customer needs with business goals? If you can take initiative, use both your analytical and creative abilities to make sound decisions and have a desire to help people solve real challenges, we want to know more about you!

As a consultant, you'll be responsible for reviewing and analyzing numerous, highly complex Programs. You'll underwrite individual risk for acceptability, pricing, coverage, terms and conditions. You'll lead in the development and integration of new and existing programs and identify new program opportunities. You will participate in making reinsurance decisions; assist in developing and implementing loss control and risk management strategies. You'll collaborate between business partners for development and implementation of program specific tools (i. e. underwriting guidelines, forms/rate filings, etc) for new programs or modifications to existing programs. You'll communicate program updates to program managers and other business liaisons. In order to succeed, you will need to build and maintain effective relationships with internal business liaisons, external program managers, and brokers. You will be responsible for the training and mentoring of underwriting team members.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serves as the primary underwriting lead for assigned programs with authority to make independent underwriting and portfolio management decisions within delegated authority levels.
  • Drives the sales and underwriting relationship for Programs products and services. Develops, recommends, and executes strategic underwriting plans for programs and is accountable for achieving targeted performance outcomes. Provides business forecasting related to trends, and profitability within Program vertical. Responsible for achieving established goals for assigned programs.
  • Analyzes program manager relationships/results and recommends corrective actions if necessary. Understands business needs and identifies new business opportunities.
  • Reviews complex individual risks, programs, or referrals within assigned territory from program managers and declines or accepts business based upon information necessary to make the decision. Risks could be guaranteed cost, quota share, shared and layered, multinational or have alternative arrangements in place that make them unique. Acts as a subject matter expert in analyzing exposures to losses; develops adequate premium charge for the exposure. Determines appropriate endorsements and exclusions to address loss exposures for the insurance contract.
  • Actively engages in discussions with reinsurers per department guidelines verifying the appropriate use of all reinsurance facilities used by the department, including various treaty, semiautomatic and facultative reinsurance. Responsible for compiling data to be provided for reinsurers presentations. Maintains good working relationships with re-insurers.
  • Develops and implements underwriting guidelines, rates, forms, product endorsements and procedures. Assists in the development of department policies and underwriting and standard methodologies.
  • Interacts with various business partners (i.e. claims, actuary, compliance, etc.) to achieve company goals and objectives. Acts as an internal consultant responsible for resolving escalated issues and communicating to business liaisons and external sources regarding program initiatives.
  • Owns the end-to-end audit process for programs, including planning, execution, findings, stakeholder communication, remediation plans, and follow-through.
  • Independently establishes and maintains effective relationships with Program Managers in order to generate growth and profitably. Travels to existing and potential program manager offices, as required for marketing visits. Frequently entertains Program Mangers to market services and ensure strong relationship to write profitable business.
  • Leads in the implementation of all new programs from development of underwriting guidelines, form/rate filings, compliance/regulatory matters, finance, reinsurance, claims, legal, accounting, actuarial and marketing matters to ensure proper program integration.
  • Attends industry functions to promote E&S or Specialty Programs brand and capabilities of the programs team in order to help identify new program business opportunities.
  • Acts as a resource for direction, training and guidance for less experienced staff. May be responsible for underwriting and support staff.
  • Maintains knowledge of insurance regulations; provides consulting regarding legislation that impacts the organization.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Senior Consultant, Director, or AVP. Acts primarily as an individual contributor; may have three or less direct reports.

Typical Skills and Experiences:


Education: Undergraduate studies with focus in Business, Finance, Accounting Economics, and/or Risk Management. Graduate degree preferred.


Experience: Typically, eight or more years’ related experience as a commercial insurance (primarily E&S) or specialty underwriter. Program leadership experience is preferred.


Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Demonstrated knowledge of commercial insurance (primarily E&S) or specialty underwriting policies, practices and procedures, insurance law and underwriting marketing principles and techniques. Strong understanding of financial documents, financial analysis, investments, market conditions essential. Must possess strong verbal and written communication skills to interact with internal/external business partners at all levels. Must have skills to influence and negotiate with internal/external business partners at all levels. Must have the ability to manage large programs; develop and apply innovative approaches to program initiatives and problem solutions. Proven ability to analyze and interpret mathematical, statistical and logical data, and evaluate its reliability and significance.


Must have project and process management skills. Must have ability to evaluate, analyze and devise solutions to complex programs; implement the most appropriate solution and monitor the effectiveness. Ability to support numerous internal/external business partners and make decisions that reflect the goals of the company, both financially and ethically. Ability to lead, train, motivate employees and set work priorities. Ability to apply/learn job related software.


Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.


Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and HR Business Partner.


Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates Nationwide Values.


Job Conditions:


Overtime Eligibility: Not Eligible (Exempt)


Working Conditions: Normal office environment. Ability to travel locally and overnight for client meetings as needed.


ADA: The above statements cover what are generally believed to be principal and essential functions of this job. Specific circumstances may allow or require some people assigned to the job to perform a somewhat different combination of duties.

We currently anticipate accepting applications until 11/08/2026. However, we encourage early submissions, as the posting may close sooner if a strong candidate slate is identified before the deadline.

Benefits

We have an array of benefits to fit your needs, including: medical/dental/vision,life insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off with newly hired associates receiving a minimum of 18 days paid time off each full calendar year pro-rated quarterly based on hire date, nine paid holidays, 8 hours of Lifetime paid time off, 8 hours of Unity Day paid time off, 401(k) with company match, company-paid pension plan, business casual attire, and more. Newsweek Recognizes Sedgwick as America’s Greatest Workplaces National Top Companies

Certified as a Great Place to Work®

Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance

Manager TVM

PRIMARY PURPOSE:

Leads the Threat and Vulnerability Management program, directing a team responsible for identifying, prioritizing, and driving remediation of vulnerabilities across enterprise systems, cloud environments, and applications. This role helps define program strategy, remediation standards, and risk-based prioritization practices, and holds technology owners accountable for meeting defined timelines. Partners with Engineering, Infrastructure, Cloud, and Security Operations to reduce exposure to emerging threats, oversees risk exception and audit processes, and reports program performance and risk trends to Security leadership and executive stakeholders.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS and RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Helps define the Threat and Vulnerability Management program strategy, roadmap, and objectives in alignment with enterprise security priorities.
  • Assist in maintaining vulnerability management policies, standards, and procedures, including remediation SLAs by severity and asset criticality.
  • Evaluate emerging threats, including AI-assisted exploit development, and adjust program priorities and processes accordingly.
  • Align TVM activities with transformation and new technology initiatives to address attack surface growth early.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop TVM Specialists and analysts, including goal setting, performance reviews, and career development.
  • Oversee risk-based prioritization of vulnerabilities using exploitability, threat intelligence, asset criticality, and business impact.
  • Direct the response to zero-day and actively exploited vulnerabilities, including escalation and executive communication.
  • Drive accountability with Engineering, Infrastructure, Cloud, and Application owners for meeting remediation timelines.
  • Lead escalation of overdue or high-risk items through defined governance channels.
  • Facilitate regular remediation forums or review meetings with remediation owners.
  • Support internal and external audits, regulatory examinations, and compliance requirements.
  • Define program metrics and key risk indicators, such as backlog, mean time to remediate, SLA compliance, and scan coverage.
  • Deliver regular reporting on exposure, trends, and program performance to Security leadership and executive stakeholders.
  • Own configuration and optimization of vulnerability scanning, attack surface management, and related tooling.
  • Manage relationships with technology vendors and service providers.
  • Identify and implement process improvements that reduce time to remediate and manual effort.
  • Benchmark the program against industry frameworks such as NIST CSF and ISO 27001.
  • Partner with Security Operations, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, and Security Architecture to share vulnerability context during active threats.
  • Participate in change control, major incident reviews, and security governance committees as required.

ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONS and RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Supports the organization's quality program(s).
  • Travel as required.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provides support, guidance, leadership and motivation to promote maximum performance.
  • Administers company personnel policies in all areas and follows company staffing standards and training recommendations.

Interviews, hires and establishes colleague performance development plans; conducts colleague performance discussions.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education & Licensing

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Management Information Systems from an accredited college or university preferred.

Preferred certifications include one or more of the following: GIAC Certified Incident Handler, GIAC Defending Advanced Threats, GIAC Certified Enterprise Defender, Microsoft Certified SOC Associate, CISSP.

Experience

  • 7 to 10 years of experience in information security, with at least 5 years focused on vulnerability management, threat management, or a closely related discipline.
  • 2 to 3 years of experience leading or supervising a team, or serving as a technical lead with formal oversight responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated experience building, operating, or maturing an enterprise vulnerability management program.
  • Hands-on knowledge of enterprise vulnerability scanning platforms (for example Tenable, Qualys, or Rapid7) and attack surface management concepts and similar technologies such as ASM, CSPM, web app and code scanning.
  • Experience applying risk-based prioritization using CVSS, EPSS, the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, threat intelligence, and asset criticality.
  • Proven ability to drive remediation accountability with Engineering, Infrastructure, Cloud, and Application teams without direct authority.
  • Experience presenting risk metrics and program performance to senior leadership.

Skills & Knowledge

  • Vulnerability management lifecycle and program design: discovery, assessment, prioritization, remediation, verification, and reporting.
  • Vulnerability scoring and threat intelligence sources, including CVSS, CVE, CWE, EPSS, and the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
  • Application security concepts, including OWASP Top 10 and the use of SAST, DAST, and SCA results.
  • Attack surface management and asset discovery concepts.
  • Attacker techniques and exploit trends, including the MITRE ATT&CK framework and the impact of AI-assisted exploit development.
  • Ticketing and workflow tools.
  • Security frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and PCI DSS.
  • Team leadership, coaching, performance management, and talent development.
  • Workload planning, prioritization, and resource forecasting.
  • Strategic planning and program roadmap development.
  • Sound judgment on risk exceptions, compensating controls, and escalation decisions.
  • Ability to analyze trends and anticipate emerging risks.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

When applicable and appropriate, consideration will be given to reasonable accommodations.

Mental: Clear and conceptual thinking ability; excellent judgment, troubleshooting, problem solving, analysis, and discretion; ability to handle work-related stress; ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously; and ability to meet deadlines

Physical: Computer keyboarding, travel as required

Auditory/Visual: Hearing, vision and talking

Looking for Builders, Not Passengers

Most engineers are given maps.

We are looking for someone who creates the roadmap.

We are building an AI company at speed. The kind where the architecture decisions made in the next 12–18 months will define our company for the next decade.

This role is not for someone who wants a comfortable sprint cycle.

It’s for someone who wants to build systems that matter, someone who is comfortable assembling parts of an airplane while the airplane is in the air.

We are looking for a Driven and Talented Software Engineer who can operate with the ownership, speed, and sound judgment of a leader.

Someone who doesn’t wait to be pointed at problems.
Someone who hunts them and solves them graciously.

The Work

You won’t be maintaining legacy systems.

You’ll be building the core systems that drive change and impact a significant number of extremely reputable and large businesses.

That means:

  • Designing architecture that scales before the scale exists

  • Turning ambiguous ideas into production systems quickly

  • Shipping fast while protecting the parts that cannot break

  • Making technical decisions with long half-lives

You will have real ownership of critical infrastructure, product, and platform decisions.

When something blocks progress, you remove the blocker.

No drama. Just velocity.

The Kind of Engineer Who Thrives Here

This role is intentionally polarizing.

You’ll probably thrive here if:

  • You build things because you can’t help yourself

  • You care deeply about craft, performance, and elegant systems

  • You move faster than most teams while maintaining high standards

  • You learn new domains faster than most people can Google them

  • You default to ownership instead of permission

You likely have at least one project where:

  • you built something that was technically extremely difficult from scratch

  • people now depend on it

  • and you did it mostly because you wanted to see if it was possible

You have very high standards.

For your code.

For your thinking.

And especially for yourself.

 

What This Is Not

This is not:

  • a maintenance role

  • a Jira-ticket factory

  • a place to hide behind processes

  • an environment tolerant of mediocre engineering

We are building with controlled velocity:

Fast without being sloppy.

Ambitious without being reckless.

 

The Upside

If you are the right person, this will be one of the most leveraged periods of your career.

You’ll get:

  • Ownership over systems that matter

  • A small team of other high-agency builders

  • Real influence on product and architecture

  • Equity that actually means something if we win

  • A front-row seat to building an AI company’s new products from the ground up

 

The Filter

This role is not for everyone.

Most engineers prefer clear maps and tickets, predictable scope, and stable systems.

If reading this made you feel slightly uncomfortable and excited at the same time, you are probably the kind of builder we are looking for.

Citizenship: U.S. Citizenship Required


Help Modernize the U.S. Army's Global Network!

Leidos is seeking a Mid-Level Orchestration & Performance Management Engineer to support the Army Global Unified Network (AGUN) Migration team.

In this remote role, you'll help modernize the Army's enterprise network by supporting network orchestration, automation, performance monitoring, and infrastructure management.

You'll work with engineering, cybersecurity, and operations teams to maintain secure network systems, improve monitoring capabilities, troubleshoot technical issues, and support network modernization.

We're looking for someone with Linux/RHEL, network performance monitoring, infrastructure automation, and systems integration experience.


What You'll Do

  • Administer and maintain Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) systems, including patching, upgrades, and security hardening.
  • Configure and support InfoVista, LiveAction, and other network performance monitoring solutions.
  • Develop and maintain network orchestration workflows, automation scripts, and monitoring dashboards.
  • Support network monitoring and analytics using SNMPv3, Elastic Stack (ELK), Kafka, and network telemetry.
  • Support data integration, logging, system health monitoring, and performance reporting.
  • Configure and troubleshoot Kubernetes, containerized applications, and virtualization environments.
  • Analyze network performance, troubleshoot infrastructure issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Support migration and integration of legacy network monitoring systems into the AGUN environment.
  • Implement DoD security requirements and STIGs.
  • Support systems integration, technical testing, and validation.
  • Develop technical documentation, network diagrams, and operational procedures.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams and provide technical support to junior engineers.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Active DoD Secret security clearance and U.S. citizenship.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related technical field with 4–8 years of relevant experience, or a master's degree with 2–6 years of relevant experience. Additional applicable experience may be considered in place of a degree.
  • DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II certification, such as CompTIA Security+, and an approved Computing Environment (CE) certification.
  • Experience supporting network orchestration, automation, network management, or infrastructure engineering.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Knowledge of systems integration, network security, and DoD STIG requirements.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate with technical teams.
  • Flexibility to work nonstandard shifts when required.
  • Willingness to travel up to 10%.

Required Technologies & Technical Skills

  • Linux/RHEL: Administration, configuration, patching, and troubleshooting.
  • Network Performance Monitoring: Familiarity with InfoVista or comparable enterprise monitoring tools.
  • Network Monitoring: SNMPv3, event management, network telemetry, and performance analysis.
  • Containers: Experience supporting Kubernetes or container-based infrastructure.
  • Elastic Stack (ELK): Familiarity with Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana.
  • Virtualization: Knowledge of VMware, KVM, or comparable technologies.
  • Enterprise Network Management: Experience with at least one of the following: Palo Alto Panorama, Cisco Prime, Cisco DNA, or Junos Space.
  • Network Automation: Experience with orchestration workflows or infrastructure configuration management.
  • Networking: Knowledge of LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, routing, and switching.
  • Security: Understanding of DoD STIGs and infrastructure hardening.

Preferred Qualifications & Technologies

  • Experience supporting U.S. Army, DISA, or other DoD enterprise networks.
  • CCNA, CCNP, Red Hat certification, or equivalent.
  • Hands-on experience with InfoVista, LiveAction, ELK, Kafka, or advanced network telemetry.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, VMware, or KVM.
  • Knowledge of Git, GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, Terraform, Puppet, or Salt.
  • Experience with Python scripting, REST APIs, and network automation.
  • Familiarity with SIEM platforms such as Splunk.
  • Experience supporting network migrations, automated workflows, and geographically dispersed networks.
  • Experience mentoring junior engineers.

Why Join Leidos?

At Leidos, you'll have the opportunity to work with advanced network monitoring and automation technologies while supporting a mission that directly impacts the U.S. Army's global communications.

If you're a cleared engineer with Linux, network monitoring, and automation experience who enjoys solving technical challenges, we'd like to hear from you!

Join Leidos and help modernize the Army's global network. Apply today!

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.
