jobs.description:
Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world.


With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research.


Make an Impact as a Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Program Manager at Worldwide


As a Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Program Manager, you'll play a critical role in advancing key information security initiatives that support business goals, regulatory commitments, and risk reduction objectives. Working within the Governance, Risk and Compliance team and reporting to the Senior Director of Governance, Risk and Compliance, you'll lead complex programs that drive meaningful security and operational outcomes across the organization.

In this highly visible role, you'll provide end-to-end leadership for a portfolio of information security and GRC programs, guiding strategy, governance, planning, execution, and long-term adoption. You'll partner closely with leaders across the Office of the CISO, Information Technology, Privacy, Legal, Quality, Vendor Management, and other business functions to ensure programs deliver measurable value and sustainable results.

Your ability to bring structure to complex initiatives, align diverse stakeholders, and provide clear executive-level insights will help strengthen security capabilities and support continued organizational success.


Where You'll Work


This is a REMOTE role open to candidates based in India. You will collaborate with global teams across multiple time zones.


What You'll Do


  • Lead multiple information security and GRC programs from strategy and planning through delivery, operational transition, and benefits realization.
  • Develop and maintain multi-year program roadmaps aligned to security priorities, regulatory requirements, audit commitments, and business objectives.
  • Establish governance frameworks, steering forums, escalation paths, and delivery standards that enable effective program execution.
  • Manage program scope, timelines, budgets, resources, risks, dependencies, and change activities across multiple workstreams.
  • Partner with project managers, workstream leaders, and vendors to ensure alignment, accountability, and successful delivery outcomes.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration across Information Security, IT, Privacy, Legal, Quality, Vendor Management, Procurement, Clinical Operations, and business teams.
  • Deliver concise, decision-focused reporting to executive leadership, including portfolio status, risks, forecasts, financials, and key milestones.
  • Oversee vendor performance, program financials, stakeholder engagement, adoption planning, and operational readiness activities.
  • Define and monitor program success metrics, risk indicators, and benefits realization while continuously improving governance and delivery practices.

What You'll Bring


  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Business, Project or Program Management, or a related field; equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience may be considered.
  • Five or more years of progressive project and program management experience, including ownership of multiple concurrent information security or cybersecurity programs.
  • Proven experience leading security programs end-to-end, including strategy, governance, planning, execution, financial oversight, executive reporting, operational transition, and benefits realization.
  • Experience delivering security initiatives such as identity and access management, vulnerability management, security operations, cloud security, data protection, third-party risk, compliance remediation, security tooling, or security transformation programs.
  • Strong understanding of program and project management disciplines, including portfolio governance, budgeting, resource management, vendor management, risk management, and benefits tracking.
  • Working knowledge of information security frameworks, controls, risk management principles, and security operations, with the ability to engage effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams, workstream leads, project managers, and vendors within a matrixed environment; experience in regulated industries such as clinical research, life sciences, healthcare, or pharmaceuticals is strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in English, along with excellent written, verbal, facilitation, negotiation, presentation, and executive communication skills; PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or similar certifications are preferred.

Discover the Difference


We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.  Discover the Difference at Worldwide Clinical Trials. Explore additional opportunities on our careers page, visit , or connect with us onLinkedIn.

jobs.title: Principal Recruiter
jobs.excerpt: Who we are We’re Ethena, an AI platform that’s revolutionizing the Compliance space.
jobs.description:
Who we are

We’re Ethena, an AI platform that’s revolutionizing the Compliance space. Our team of agents helps Compliance and People leaders run proactive Compliance programs that drive real behavior change.

From Policies and Disclosures to Training, Hotline, and Analytics, our agents work together to drive smarter, faster, human-led decision-making. Hotline and training data rolls up into fully customizable, board-ready risk reports. Our AI call taker synthesizes data to recommend improvements to company policies and training. Every signal lands in one place, so Compliance leaders can spot risk early and fix it before it becomes a problem. The agents do the legwork, and people make every judgment call.

More than 2,000 organizations, from Pinterest and Zendesk to the Salvation Army, run their programs on Ethena. That covers millions of employees, from the warehouse floor to desktop workers. Learners give our training a 93% approval rating, 96% of customers renew, and our business is growing quickly with 50%+ YoY revenue growth.

Lots of companies call themselves AI-forward. We’ve actually built the tools to prove it. Come help us build what’s next.

How we work

We’re a team that values diversity in all its forms and loves adding new perspectives. We ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and build with empathy — for customers and each other. We're passionate about the work we do, love feedback, and lead with high agency and accountability. When we see something that could be better, we step up to the plate and do something about it. We take our work seriously, but are careful not to take ourselves too seriously. Because doing great work should be fun.
Our workforce is fully remote, and your personal working hours can be based on your own timezone. All team-wide meetings are scheduled to be inclusive of all North American time zones.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for a Principal Recruiter who loves the craft of recruiting and wants to do it at the highest level.

You’ll own full-cycle hiring across every team at Ethena, from Sales and CS to Product and G&A, and at every level, from entry-level roles to executive leaders. You’ll be a true strategic partner to our hiring managers. You’ll get deep on what each team is building, partner with them on turning their needs into a smart recruiting plan, and bring them rockstar candidates. You’ll move fast, keep everyone in the loop, and never trade quality for speed. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with lots of autonomy, reporting to our Chief People Officer.

If you get excited about finding the perfect person for a team and running a great process from start to finish, we’d love to meet you.

What you’ll do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting across every function and level, from first conversation to signed offer.

  • Partner with each hiring manager to build the plan for every role from A to Z, including the right level and candidate profile, the interview structure, what each interviewer should assess, and a realistic timeline.

  • Get deep on the business. Learn where each team is headed, what their top priorities are, and what great looks like in the role, so you can speak to it and sell it with confidence.

  • Source like an expert. Balance inbound applicants and active outreach, and decide for yourself how to split your effort on each role to get the best outcome quickly.

  • Screen with a high bar, so every candidate who reaches a hiring manager is an obvious yes for a conversation and it’s clear why you passed them along.

  • Help hiring managers sell the role well and ask the right questions, so we land great people and make smart, well-informed hiring decisions.

  • Bring market insight back to the team, from comp trends to talent availability, and adjust the strategy when the data says we should.

  • Keep momentum high. Give hiring managers regular, clear updates so they always know where their pipeline stands and feel confident it’s moving in the right direction.

  • Run a full-service process, including scheduling your own interviews, coordinating loops, and making sure every candidate has a great experience with Ethena.

What makes a great candidate

  • You’re a career recruiter who has owned full-cycle searches across a wide range of functions, including Sales, CS, Product, and G&A.

  • You’ve recruited at every level, from entry-level hires to executive leaders, and you’ve been a trusted partner to senior leaders on their most important hires.

  • You’ve done in-house recruiting at a high-growth, early stage tech startup, and you know how to keep quality high while the business moves fast.

  • You’re an expert sourcer who’s as comfortable building a pipeline from scratch as you are working through inbound applicants.

  • You’re genuinely curious about the business. You want to understand each team’s strategy and priorities because it makes you a better recruiter.

  • You adapt your communication style and way of working to each hiring manager, from the founder who wants a quick daily ping to the leader who wants a detailed weekly pipeline review.

  • You’re relentless about filling roles quickly without lowering the bar.

  • You’re proactive with updates, so hiring managers never have to chase you to know where things stand.

  • You’re highly autonomous and happy to roll up your sleeves, from writing outreach to scheduling interviews.

  • You’re AI-native. You already use Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools to recruit efficiently and amplify your impact, and you’d rather build a tool than add a manual step.

  • This role isn’t for you if you want to build and manage a team of recruiters, specialize in one function or level, or hand off the coordination and scheduling side of the process.

At Ethena, we're committed to fair and equitable compensation. We carefully evaluate each candidate's skills and qualifications to provide our best possible offer upfront. Our no-negotiation policy ensures that our first offer is always our best offer, promoting pay equity throughout our organization.

Physical Demands

This is sedentary work that primarily involves sitting/standing in a home office environment.

Location

Ethena is a remote-first organization and is currently hiring candidates based in the United States.
We are not currently offering employer visa sponsorship for this role.

AI Usage in Interviews:

We’re big fans of AI and use it heavily in our day-to-day work. That said, to ensure fairness and accurate skill assessment, we do not allow the use of AI tools (including note takers, transcription tools, or recordings) during interviews. If you have questions or need accommodations, we’re happy to chat — just let us know.

Benefits

The benefits offered for this position can be found here. We provide unlimited PTO.

How to Apply

Applications for this position will be accepted via our job board. Excited about the opportunity, but worried you don’t meet all the requirements? Apply anyway, and give us both the chance to find out. We welcome you to read more about our approach to job descriptions by our Chief People Officer, Melanie Naranjo. Curious to know what it’s like to interview with us? Read more here.
Ethena is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a successful organization is one that celebrates its employees for who they are, who they love, and the unique lens through which they experience the world. Ethena does not discriminate based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, Veteran status, or other legally protected status. We understand that our differences make us better. They empower us to learn from each other, lean on each other, and create a product and community that models the behavior we hope to see in others.

Cyber Integration Deputy Team Lead

Location: Remote

The Decision Advantage Business Area within Defense at Leidos is looking for a highly qualified Secret cleared Cyber Integration Deputy Team Lead.

This is an exciting opportunity to bring your experience to support all-domain large-scale weapon systems, Information Technology Systems, and Command and Control Systems to realize the Department of Defense Joint All-Domain Command and Control (JADC2). In this role, you will support the Advanced Battle Management System (ABMS) Digital Infrastructure (DI) Processing Node (PN) team to design and implement solutions that can be delivered at speed, scale, and with the necessary security to deliver operational advantages to the joint warfighter. ABMS is a top modernization priority for the Department of the Air Force and will be the backbone of a network-centric approach to battle management in partnership with all the services across JADC2. This position will work closely with Program Managers, domain engineers, and Government counterparts across Government and Industry partners.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Provides technical expertise and leadership on cyber implementation for development projects and acts as a backup to the Cyber Integration Team Lead.
  • Provides oversight to changes in hardware, software, or network configuration and implements best practices in securing the infrastructure.
  • Provides guidance to team members to ensure efforts align with the goals set forth by the Cyber Integration Team Lead.
  • Works on cybersecurity items and system bug resolution as required.
  • Implements highly technical solutions using various advanced technologies.
  • Assists in managing and monitoring Jira tasking and artifacts.
  • Coordinates with the Cyber Integration Team Lead to plan and assign work.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree with 8-12 years relevant experience and at least 3 years experience leading highly technical, diverse, and decentralized team. Additional years of experience will be considered in lieu of degree.
  • Active and current Secret clearance with ability to obtain and maintain TS/SCI.
  • Knowledge of security principles and practices for Infrastructure as Code (IaC), using tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
  • Demonstrated ability to embed security practices and testing into the continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipeline.
  • Experience with Tenable Nessus, Nessus Manager, and Tenable.sc, or other vulnerability scanning and management.
  • Basic working knowledge of DISA STIGs, including the ability to apply, verify, and document compliance.
  • Experience conducting and documenting threat modeling exercises.
  • Experience with RHEL and/or Windows and/or Network Device hardening and vulnerability management. Basic fluency in each operating system.
  • Proven collaborator with excellent communication skills, able to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • DoD 8570 Level 2 certified
  • Familiarity with Agile Management to include use of JIRA.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Integration of cyber requirements with new technologies, such as Commercial Solutions for Classified (CSfC).
  • Experience in managing eMASS and Xacta RMF packages and associated artifacts from initiation through continuous monitoring.
  • Knowledge of Classified Cloud Environments and the Shared Responsibility Model.
  • Other relevant cybersecurity certifications like SSCP, CCSP, CEH, PenTest+, Cloud+, GIAC, GCED, GCIH or CySA+ are a plus.
  • Background in implementing, fielding, and authorizing CDS solutions.
  • TS/SCI clearance.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.excerpt: Arcadia is dedicated to happier, healthier days for all.
jobs.description:
Arcadia is dedicated to happier, healthier days for all. We believe that there is a better healthcare world—one powered by data. Our platform transforms complex, diverse data into a unified foundation for health, helping organizations deliver better care, boost revenue, and lower costs.
We're a team of fiercely driven individuals committed to making healthcare more sustainable—and we're looking for passionate people to help us get there.
For more information, visit .

Why This Role Is Important to Arcadia

Arcadia's petabyte-scale data platform is at the heart of everything the company does; everyone from our external customers to our engineers, from our analysts to our sales team, depends on it. They don't just use it; they build on it. This data platform needs to enable a shared ownership model, so the platform team can scale and internal teams can move fast. This role sets how we build and run it.
The role reports directly to the VP of Engineering.

What Success Looks Like

The data platform provides building blocks, from catalog and pipelines to databases, queues, and storage, that come pre-wired with connectivity, logging, metrics, tracing, alerts, encryption, access controls, backups, and cost tags—all with sensible defaults.
Internal teams own and change their pipelines, environments, alerts, and SLOs. When something breaks, the owning team sees it first, traces it to the root cause, and addresses it themselves. They see their own quality numbers and cloud spend, and act on them. Data platform engineers spend their time building capabilities, not working tickets.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Partner with internal teams to prioritize, implement, and roll out features they depend on—from enabling self-service ETL authoring to provisioning new data stores, from establishing data quality metrics to optimizing performance.
  • Evaluate new technologies and architectures, prototype them, and roll them out as new capabilities across the platform.
  • Write a meaningful share of the production code.
  • Work closely with our AWS infrastructure team on the platform's network, compute, and security.
  • Push quality attributes into the platform, especially as AI increases the volume of changes. We need the platform itself to be stable, resilient, performant, and cost-effective. Internal teams that build on it need to be able to configure their own SLIs/SLOs and focus on data quality.
  • Run the platform as an internal product: find what slows teams down, pick the few capabilities worth building, publish the roadmap, and measure adoption, delivery speed, stability, and developer satisfaction.
  • Drive migrations to completion: track usage, automate instead of handing out checklists, push through the final 20%, and sunset legacy systems.
  • Set technical direction, evolve the platform, and coach other engineers through design partnership and review.
  • Building data engineering tooling on top of our internal AI platform.

What You'll Bring

  • Deep experience in data engineering—from columnar stores to data lakes, from distributed processing to SQL optimization.
  • Expertise in software engineering—CI/CD, testing, architecture, source control, automation, observability, modularity and reuse, and fluency in Python, Java, or Scala.
  • Modern data stack experience (e.g. data contracts and data products, dbt, Spark, Dagster, Iceberg and Parquet, notebooks and BI, data catalogs and data quality).
  • Strong AWS experience since the platform is built on its network, storage, and compute primitives.
  • Experience building with AI.
  • Reliability you've owned: SLOs, observability, on-call, and incident response.
  • Current, hands-on production coding, the habit of figuring things out (research, spike, deliver), and relentless pragmatism about what's worth building.
  • A track record of driving change across the org.

Would Love for You to Have

  • Regulated-data experience (HIPAA, PHI, SOC 2 or HITRUST environments).
  • A public voice through talks, writing, or open source.
  • Experience turning a data engineering team into a product-minded platform team complete with processes, stakeholder management, and a roadmap.
  • Experience building platform support that scales: support tiers, office hours, docs, shared ownership principles, escalation processes, and developer advocacy.
  • No healthcare background required.

What You'll Get

  • The opportunity to shape Arcadia's data platform and its direction for years to come.
  • Direct influence on how Arcadia's engineering org works on a daily basis through tooling, patterns, and standards.
  • Remote-first across the US, with in-person hubs growing in Boston, DC, and NYC.
  • A flexible culture with personality and heart, named a Built In 2026 Best Place to Work.
  • Work that shows up in patients' lives.

About Arcadia

Arcadia.io helps innovative providers and payers across the country transform healthcare to reduce cost while improving patient health. We do this by aggregating large amounts of disparate data, applying algorithms to identify opportunities to provide better patient care, and making those opportunities actionable by physicians at the point of care in near-real time. We are passionate about helping our customers drive meaningful outcomes. We are growing fast and have emerged as a market leader in the highly competitive population health management software market and have been recognized by industry analysts KLAS, IDC, Forrester, and Chilmark for our leadership. For a better sense of our brand and products, please explore our website.

Protect Yourself

If you have concerns about the authenticity of a job offer or recruitment-related communication claiming to be from Arcadia, we encourage you to verify by contacting us directly at (781) 202-3600 and select option 3. For more information, visit our website.

Who we are

More than 2,000 organizations, from Pinterest and Zendesk to the Salvation Army, run their programs on Ethena. That covers millions of employees, from the warehouse floor to desktop workers. Learners give our training a 93% approval rating, 96% of customers renew, and our business is growing quickly with 50%+ YoY revenue growth.

Lots of companies call themselves AI-forward. We’ve actually built the tools to prove it. Come help us build what’s next.

How we work

We’re a team that values diversity in all its forms and loves adding new perspectives. We ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and build with empathy — for customers and each other. We're passionate about the work we do, love feedback, and lead with high agency and accountability. When we see something that could be better, we step up to the plate and do something about it. We take our work seriously, but are careful not to take ourselves too seriously. Because doing great work should be fun.
Our workforce is fully remote, and your personal working hours can be based on your own timezone. All team-wide meetings are scheduled to be inclusive of all North American time zones.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for a hungry, resourceful Senior Accountant who’s ready to run accounting at Ethena end to end. You’ll own everything from month-end close and billing to collections and commission statements. You’ll also have the autonomy to rebuild how we do it, making it faster, cleaner, and more automated. This is a great fit for someone with solid accounting experience who wants to take what they’ve learned, run the whole process, and put their automation skills to the test. You’ll report to our Head of Finance and work closely with Sales, CS, RevOps, and People. When you see a problem, you fix it. When a process works, you find a way to make it better.

What you’ll do

  • Own the month-end and year-end close, delivering accurate, timely financials in accordance with US GAAP, and keep making the close faster.

  • Run billing end to end. Keep our billing system (Maxio) current, set up new contracts accurately, and answer ad hoc billing and order form questions from Sales and CS.

  • Own collections, keeping AR current and following up with customers so cash comes in on time.

  • Reconcile revenue and contract data between Salesforce and Maxio so our ARR, revenue, and forecast numbers always match.

  • Apply revenue recognition under ASC 606 to every deal, including ramps, free periods, and implementation fees, and flag non-standard terms to the Head of Finance.

  • Send out comp plans and process commission statements accurately and on time, in partnership with RevOps and People.

  • Manage AP and procure-to-pay so vendors are paid accurately, on time, and with the right approvals.

  • Automate the manual work. Replace hand entry and spreadsheet-by-spreadsheet reconciliations with integrations, AI tools, and repeatable workflows.

  • Document processes and controls so our accounting holds up to audit and scales as we grow.

  • Support the annual audit, tax filings, and the Head of Finance’s planning and board reporting with clean, reliable numbers.

What makes a great candidate

  • You’ve owned a meaningful part of the accounting process at a fast-growing company, ideally SaaS, and you’re ready to run all of it.

  • You’ve worked hands-on with month-end close, billing, AR, and revenue recognition, and you understand how SaaS contracts flow from CRM to billing to the books.

  • You’re AI-forward. You already use Claude, ChatGPT, or automation tools to do your work faster, and you’d rather build a tool than repeat a manual step.

  • You’re a self-starter who takes ownership. You spot problems before anyone asks and fix them without waiting for permission.

  • You take pride in leveling up processes and always look for a cleaner, faster, more automated way to get the work done.

  • You’re fast and scrappy, and you’re comfortable switching between a billing question, a commission statement, and the close all in the same afternoon.

  • You hold yourself to a high bar for rigor and accuracy. You set clear deadlines, communicate them, and hit them.

  • You’re resourceful. When you don’t know the answer, you figure it out.

  • You can explain accounting clearly to people who aren’t accountants, from sales reps with billing questions to department heads.

  • You thrive on a fully distributed team

  • This role probably isn’t for you if you prefer a narrow, specialized scope or a steady routine. The work spans the full accounting function and changes day to day.

  • It also probably isn’t for you if you’d rather follow an established playbook than build one. Here, you’ll design the processes yourself.

Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care.

With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software.

Description

We’re growing and looking to hire an experienced OT Cybersecurity professional with a strong background in consulting and Cybersecurity services to join our Advanced Service Team at Claroty, who embodies our core values: People First, Customer Obsession, Strive for Excellence, and Integrity.

About the Company:

Claroty is a global leader in cyber-physical systems (CPS) protection, dedicated to securing the critical infrastructure that keeps the world running. We’re a fast-growing, award-winning team where innovation meets purpose—and we want you to help us define the future of cybersecurity.

About the Role:

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated OT Cybersecurity Architect to join our Advanced Services team. The ideal candidate will be a T-shaped professional with deep expertise in Operational Technology (OT) and Industrial Control Systems (ICS) security architecture, coupled with strong technical skills in network segmentation, IT/OT convergence, and technical documentation. This role is crucial for designing resilient security architectures for our customer base, strengthening operational cybersecurity posture through risk-based engineering, and ensuring architectural designs and technical documentation meet industry standards and compliance requirements (such as IEC 62443 and NIST).

Responsibilities

As an OT Cybersecurity Architect, your impact will be:

Responsible for orchestrating the delivery of security services to customers, ensuring the entire program aligns with established frameworks, and producing the necessary documentation and tooling for both internal teams and external clients.

  • Provide technical direction and act as a subject matter expert as it relates to Claroty´s product portfolio & cybersecurity.
  • Ensure our products are effectively deployed, integrated, assessed, and optimized in alignment with effective security metrics.
  • Interpret requirements across risk, secure architecture, incident management and governance.
  • Support cybersecurity investigations within OT environments using Claroty products.
  • Deliver workshops, training, and threat intelligence sharing sessions.
  • Provide advisory, presentations and reports to customers.
  • Create collateral around GRC such as policies, standards, procedures, playbooks, runbooks and standard operating procedures.
  • Create reports of emerging threats to industrial networks for Customers.
  • Leverage AI and machine learning tools to automate passive ICS/OT asset inventory, baseline industrial network behavior, and prioritize remediation based on physical process risk.
  • Work closely with R&D teams or other internal departments to improve and enhance the products and services offered by Claroty.

Requirements

What do you need to succeed in this role?

  • Desired: 3+ years of work experience in Operational Technology Security as a consultant or service delivery expert
  • Experience with the application of threat modelling or other risk identification techniques
  • Understanding of IT and OT network communication protocols
  • Knowledge and understanding of various security control frameworks (e.g., IEC 62443, NERC CIP, NIST, NCSC CAF and/or other relevant frameworks)
  • Knowledge and experience of cybersecurity assessments in ICS/OT & IT security
  • Understanding of operational technologies such as Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) software, RTUs, HMI and Distributed Control Systems (DCS)
  • Basic experience with network forensics, threat intelligence & incident response (Wireshark, etc.)
  • Experience with Azure, Power BI, Python and SQL creation and scripting
  • Familiarity with Linux and Windows operating systems and administrative tools
  • Ability to successfully communicate & present to a range of technical and executive stakeholders
  • Excellent report-writing skills
  • Willingness to travel.

About Claroty

Claroty empowers organizations to protect the mission-critical infrastructure that underpins modern life. The AI-powered Claroty Platform serves as the single source of operational truth, providing the deepest visibility and broadest protection across cyber-physical systems (CPS), leveraging five core solutions: asset inventory, exposure management, network protection, secure access, and threat detection. Claroty helps organizations operationalize CPS protection through a programmatic approach designed to reduce risk, maintain operational integrity, and meet compliance–whether in the cloud with Claroty xDome or on-premises with Claroty Continuous Threat Detection (CTD). Claroty is deployed by hundreds of organizations at thousands of sites globally. The company is headquartered in New York City and has a presence in Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America. To learn more, visit.

Claroty is widely recognized as the industry leader in CPS protection, backed by the world’s largest investment firms and industrial automation vendors. The company has been named a Leader in2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for CPS Protection Platforms two years in a row, a Customer’s Choice in the2026 Gartner® Peer Insights™ Voice of the Customer for CPS Protection Platforms, and a Leader and a Customer Favorite inThe Forrester Wave™: Operational Technology Security Solutions, Q3 2026. Claroty has also been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 for multiple consecutive years.

The expected base salary range for this role is between $150,000 - $160,000, determined by objective criteria including skills, qualifications, and experience level. This range represents base salary only and does not include variable compensation components such as equity or bonuses. Details regarding the broader total rewards package will be shared prior to interviews. Claroty is an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment for all. We encourage applications from candidates of ALL backgrounds, and special accommodations are available upon request in all selection phases.

jobs.excerpt: Description We're looking for a hands-on Customer Success Engineer who owns customer relationships, drives customer outcomes, and enjoys solving complex data problems.
jobs.description:
Description

We're looking for a hands-on Customer Success Engineer who owns customer relationships, drives customer outcomes, and enjoys solving complex data problems.

We're taking a different approach to Customer Success. Rather than primarily coaching customers on how to use Insycle, our team works directly in their environments to investigate problems, build solutions, and deliver results. Think of it as Customer Success with a Forward Deployed Engineer mindset.

With our secure Support Access, you'll be able to configure and test solutions directly in customers' Insycle environments. Customers retain control over approving and executing changes to their CRM data.

You'll own a portfolio of customers across onboarding, ongoing adoption, renewals, and expansion. You'll build relationships, understand customers' business challenges, and help them get lasting value from Insycle.

This role combines hands-on technical problem-solving with customer relationships and business understanding. You'll have the autonomy to investigate challenges, design practical solutions, and see your work make a difference.

Location: Remote. We're looking for candidates based in the United Kingdom who can collaborate effectively with our team and customers across different time zones.

What you’ll do

Solve customer data challenges

  • Understand customers' business goals and translate their requirements into practical data solutions.
  • Investigate CRM records, fields, workflows, and existing configurations to understand problems and identify root causes.
  • Configure Blueprints, templates, matching rules, transformations, associations, assignments, and other Insycle capabilities on customers' behalf.
  • Test solutions against real customer data, review previews, investigate edge cases, and refine configurations until they produce the expected results.
  • Choose simple, reliable solutions that customers can understand and maintain, and follow through to ensure the original problem is resolved.

Drive adoption and customer outcomes

  • Lead customer onboarding, configuring initial use cases and helping customers achieve results quickly.
  • Help customers move from one-time cleanup to continuous data integrity using Blueprints, Data Logic, and Observability.
  • Proactively review customer usage, identify opportunities to improve workflows, and recommend additional use cases.
  • Monitor adoption, address challenges early, and help customers get sustained value from Insycle.

Build relationships and grow accounts

  • Own customer relationships across onboarding, ongoing use, renewals, and expansion.
  • Become a trusted partner by understanding customers' priorities, offering practical recommendations, and following through.
  • Identify opportunities to expand Insycle usage across teams, CRM objects, and business processes.
  • Communicate business value through measurable results, including time saved, data quality improvements, and reduced operational risk.
  • Proactively manage customer relationships, identify adoption and retention risks, initiate outreach when intervention is needed, and help customers achieve the outcomes that support renewal and growth.

Improve how we work

  • Share knowledge, document reusable solutions, and collaborate with teammates to solve challenging problems.
  • Identify recurring customer issues and contribute ideas to improve the product, onboarding, and customer experience.
  • Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude to investigate problems, explore solutions, and improve workflows, while validating the results.
  • Take initiative to improve processes, learn from feedback, and help the team become more effective.

Requirements

  • Relevant experience: You have 3+ years of experience in technical Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Solutions Consulting, Implementation, RevOps, or a similar customer-facing B2B SaaS role.
  • Customer account ownership: You have experience directly managing ongoing customer relationships or a portfolio of accounts, taking responsibility for customer outcomes, adoption, and retention—not solely responding to technical support requests.
  • Technical problem-solving: You enjoy investigating complex problems, working with data, asking thoughtful questions, and finding practical solutions.
  • CRM and data experience: You're comfortable with HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar platforms, including data management, business rules, workflows, and automation.
  • Ownership and initiative: You work independently, take responsibility for outcomes, and follow through without needing constant direction.
  • Customer communication: You can explain technical concepts clearly, understand business needs, and build strong customer relationships.
  • Judgment and attention to detail: You think through consequences, validate your work, and favor simple, reliable solutions.
  • Teamwork and growth: You enjoy collaborating, sharing knowledge, learning from feedback, and helping the team improve.

Experience with CRM data quality, deduplication, data transformation, record matching, or integrations is a plus. Software development experience is not required.

Why join Insycle

You'll work on real data challenges across a wide range of customers and industries, with the tools and autonomy to investigate problems and build solutions yourself. You'll see the results of your work directly and build strong relationships with the people you help.

We're a small team with an established product and ambitious plans. You'll have the opportunity to influence how we serve customers, improve our product, and help shape the next stage of Insycle's growth.

How we work

Our values shape how we work together, make decisions, and develop as a team:

  • Care deeply: Understand customers' needs and take initiative to help them succeed.
  • Everyone builds: Look for opportunities to improve how we work and contribute practical solutions.
  • Better together: Share knowledge, support teammates, and work toward shared success.
  • Quality counts: Think through the details, validate your work, and deliver reliable results.
  • Positive energy: Bring kindness, constructive communication, and a willingness to tackle challenges.
  • Own the outcome: Take responsibility, follow through, and deliver results.
  • Choose simplicity: Favor practical, reliable solutions over unnecessary complexity.
  • Raise the bar: Seek feedback, keep learning, and help others improve.

Compensation and benefits

  • Annual base salary of £55,000–£65,000, depending on relevant experience and location.
  • Annual performance-based bonus with a target of 10% of base salary.
  • Equity through stock options.
  • Paid time off, sick leave, flexibility for unexpected needs, and paid holidays.

Company Overview

Insycle builds data integrity infrastructure for the agentic CRM. More than 700 customers trust our tools to resolve duplicates, standardize data, manage imports, and connect related records in platforms such as HubSpot and Salesforce.

Those tools fix what’s wrong today. But clean data is a moment. Data integrity is a system.

Our platform helps businesses define what right looks like in Blueprints, continuously apply those standards through Data Logic, and use Observability to understand where data conforms, where it drifts, and whether it stays aligned over time.

As AI agents increasingly use CRM data to make decisions and write changes back, that foundation becomes essential. Businesses need reliable inputs and a system that detects when people, integrations, workflows, or agents move data away from their standards.

We’re a B2B SaaS company with an established customer base and a much larger ambition: to make data integrity foundational to how businesses operate with AI.

In this role, you will help improve model quality, latency, throughput, and GPU efficiency while contributing to real-time audio intelligence pipelines for high-performance, low-latency applications.


This is an opportunity for a senior-level AI/ML engineer who enjoys working close to the model, the infrastructure, and the performance benchmarks—building scalable ML systems that are ready for production.

  • Practical experience using vLLM or SGLang for high-performance model inference.
  • Deep understanding of GPU utilization, CUDA fundamentals, KV caching, and memory optimization.
  • Experience evaluating and improving model precision, recall, latency, throughput, and inference performance.
  • Strong Python programming and ML engineering skills.
  • Proven ability to benchmark, debug, and optimize models for production environments.
  • Experience fine-tuning and deploying Alibaba Qwen models is preferred.
  • Experience with real-time audio AI, speech recognition, ASR, or audio classification is preferred.
  • Experience optimizing AI models for high-throughput, low-latency production environments is preferred.
  • Ability to work hands-on across both SLM model training/fine-tuning and GPU inference optimization.

jobs.description:
Silverback Strategies is a performance marketing agency built to help marketers grow and capitalize on change. Ad Age, Inc Magazine, The Washington Post, The Washingtonian, and The Washington Business Journal have recognized Silverback as one of the best places to work.
We hire the best and help them get better. Silverbackers are supported, challenged and inspired by their peers. Regardless of title or tenure, every Silverbacker plays a role in helping our agency get better. This is a place where you can make a difference.

Job Highlights:

  • Role: Growth Manager, Marketing & Sales

  • Department: Sales/Marketing

  • Salary Band: $100,000 - $125,000

  • Location: Remote (U.S.)

  • Position Status: Actively hiring for this role

  • Application Deadline: We review applications on a rolling basis, so there’s no cutoff date. If this job sounds like you, go for it.

Today, we're looking for a Growth Manager, Marketing & Sales to join our team. Our new Growth Manager will be the first conversation many senior marketing leaders have with Silverback, and the person who helps turn those conversations into clients. You'll work on new business from first touch to signed contract: qualifying inbound leads, building the pitches and proposals that win the work, keeping prospects engaged until they're ready to buy, and supporting the marketing programs that bring the next ones in.

This isn't an account management role. Once a client signs, our account teams own the relationship and the day-to-day work, so you stay focused on winning the next one. It's also not a cold-calling job: you'll work inbound leads that come from our marketing, referrals and thought leadership. You don't need formal sales training. You'll learn our methodology and sales process on live deals alongside our Chief Revenue Officer, then take on more of the pitching yourself over time. This role is ideal for a marketer who's comfortable in front of a CMO, picks up new frameworks fast, and wants to see their work show up as new revenue.

Here's what we expect from our Growth Manager, Marketing & Sales.

—What You'll Do—

  • Lead Qualification & Discovery: Be the first point of contact for every inbound lead. Research each company, judge how well it fits the clients we serve best, and run intro and discovery calls to find the opportunities worth pursuing.

  • Qualification Automation: Use HubSpot and AI tools like Claude to automate how leads are routed, researched, scored and followed up with, so we respond faster and more accurately as volume grows.

  • Sales Materials: Build the decks, audits, proposals and contracts that win new business. Partner with experts across our Paid Media, SEO, Measurement and Creative teams to tell a story that speaks to each buyer's goals.

  • Pitching & Opportunity Management: Start by supporting pitches alongside our Chief Revenue Officer, then grow into leading them yourself: presenting our approach, managing deals from first call to signed contract, and bringing in the right Silverback experts along the way.

  • Pipeline Management: Own HubSpot as our record of every lead, contact and deal. Keep it current so our forecasts are reliable and every lead gets the right follow-up.

  • Prospect Nurture: Segment our HubSpot contacts by engagement, fit and readiness to buy, then build and run email programs that keep Silverback top of mind with prospects who aren't ready yet and past opportunities worth reopening.

  • Gifting & Customer Marketing: Run and grow our client and prospect gifting program around personal and professional milestones, and expand it into a broader customer marketing program that drives referrals, repeat business and growth with existing clients.

—What We're Looking For—

  • Years of Experience: 4-6 years in marketing, account management or growth roles, ideally at a digital marketing agency or professional services firm.

  • Executive Presence: You're comfortable leading a conversation with a VP, CMO or CEO. You listen well, ask sharp questions and hold the room.

  • Sales Acumen: You know how to uncover what a prospect needs, handle objections and move a decision forward. Experience as an account executive is a plus, not a requirement.

  • Marketing Fluency: You have a background in paid media, SEO or measurement, so our methodology clicks quickly and you can speak credibly about what drives results.

  • Writing: You write and edit cleanly and pick up a brand voice fast. You can take a rough draft and make it sound like a person wrote it.

  • Frameworks in Plain Language: You pick up a framework quickly and can explain it to a buyer in plain English.

  • CRM & Automation: You have hands-on HubSpot experience. You keep records clean, segment lists by engagement and fit, and build workflows. You're curious about using AI to take manual work out of the process.

  • Ownership: You don't need a perfect playbook. You can be handed a problem or goal, and you run with it.

—Why Silverback?—

    Silverback isn’t for everybody. If you’re an A player, you will get paid more, learn more and grow faster with support from a smart and fun team. If you’re a B player, you will be miserable.

  • Work with the A team: We are ruthless about putting the best possible team on the field.

  • Make an impact: We’re a small agency. Everybody has the opportunity to drive change and impact.

product testing and product development work. We design and conduct
In-Home Usage Testing (IHUT) locally and nationally to provide actual
user feedback to consumers and market research firms to evaluate
products, packaging, related product instructions and more.

provide product testers to companies for evaluating the in-home
experience with a wide variety of products to ensure proper product

certification and greater market access.

Please note that although this job can be done from home 95% of the
time, very occasionally In-Home Product Testers may be asked to visit

training or meetings (visits are local and scheduled at no more than 20
minutes drive from the In-Home Usage Tester address). These optional

visits are also paid by the hour.

During your application process, we will determine your consumer
profile and establish what products would be suitable for you to test

target certain types of consumers, to ensure the right participants are

test and that they have a balance of demographics and attitudes.

Schedules may include tasks to do such as: unpacking, reading

Some In-Home Usage Tests projects may require participants to use

Paid Product Testing is done from home 95% of the time, but very

What if your Spanish language skills could help improve the AI.  

PROJECT DETAILS  

  • Job Title: Hydrus - Voice Contributor - Spanish(Peru)

  • Project Overview: a scripted and conversational audio data collection project

  • Language: Spanish(Peru)

  • Location: Remote (Peru)

  • Compensation: 35USD per hour

   

WHAT YOU’LL DO  

  • Two supervised sessions of approximately 4 hours each, guided in real time by a Session Director on a separate recording platform. 

  • Record scripted material in a natural, conversational tone — faithfully, without a polished, performed, or “announcer” delivery. 

  • Record unscripted, spontaneous speech on a given topic, matching the same warmth and pace as your scripted takes. 

  • Set up and manage your own recording space and equipment for session recording. 

  • Deliver all recordings entirely in the required language (with specific dialect), without code-switching into other languages or dialects. 
     

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 

Required 

  • Experience as a voice actor, actor, or theater performer, or a comparable performance background. 

  • Native or native-equivalent fluency in the required language and dialect, with the ability to deliver natural, everyday-sounding speech both when reading a script and speaking spontaneously.

  • Access to a quiet recording space, free of echo and background noise (acoustically treated for session recording, if selected). 

  • Owns or will acquire a dedicated, professional-grade microphone for the audition (e.g. RODE NT-USB Mini, Blue Yeti), upgrading to a qualifying USB condenser or XLR mic + audio interface for session recording if selected. Built-in laptop mics, AirPods, earbuds, and headsets are not accepted at any stage. 

  • Owns closed-back monitoring headphones (required for session recording if selected). 

  • Comfortable both self-directing for the audition and taking live direction from a Session Director in guided sessions. 

Preferred (nice to have, not required) 

  • Professional voice-over experience (dubbing/ADR, audiobook, podcasting) in a conversational rather than commercial/announcer register. 

  • Baseline audio hygiene: comfortable setting mic distance and catching noise, clipping, or distortion yourself. 

  • An existing home recording setup already treated for sound. 

 

Please note: the recordings you produce may be used to create synthesized, AI-generated voices for conversational AI products. Full details on how your data is collected, used, shared, and retained are set out in a Consent Form, which you'll review and sign before any paid session recording begins. 

 

Your Data & Privacy 

Before any session recording, you'll be asked to review and sign a Consent Form covering how your voice recordings are collected, used (including to train synthesized/AI voice models), shared with approved partners, retained, and how to exercise your data rights (access, correction, deletion, and more, depending on where you live). If you'd like to review these terms before applying, contact us and we'll share a copy in advance.

jobs.excerpt: Req ID:392719 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us.
jobs.description:
Req ID:392719

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Data Migration Engineer (Informatica/DBT) to join our team remotely in the US.

Role Overview
o The Senior Data Migration Engineer serves as a hands-on technical contributor and delivery anchor, responsible for designing and implementing Python-based extract/load pipelines, dbt-based transformations, and Airflow-based orchestration for a large-scale migration from Informatica PowerCenter to a modern data stack.
o This role requires deep expertise in converting complex Informatica workflows into Python, dbt, and Airflow, and the ability to deliver production-quality, functionally equivalent output at enterprise scale.

Key Responsibilities:
• Assess complex Informatica workflows including sessions, mappings, and parameterizations and translate them into equivalent Python EL scripts and dbt transformation models.
• Develop and maintain Python EL pipelines to land high-volume data, including billion-row tables, into the target warehouse using SQLAlchemy, cx_Oracle, pyodbc, and bulk export tools such as Oracle Data Pump and SQL Server BCP.
• Design and develop dbt transformation models based on Informatica mapping logic, incorporating dbt best practices including model layering, macros, incremental strategies, and snapshot patterns.
• Develop dbt-native tests as well as custom Python unit tests to validate transformation correctness and data quality.
• Develop Airflow DAGs to orchestrate Python EL and dbt scripts end-to-end, producing output that is functionally equivalent to the source Informatica workflows.
• Contribute to GitLab CI/CD pipeline for dbt and Airflow code, including lint gates, automated testing, and deployment to shared NAS.
• Perform peer code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback to fellow engineers.
• Troubleshoot performance issues and data discrepancies during SIT and UAT, including row-count reconciliation between source Oracle/SQL Server systems and the target warehouse.
• Contribute to technical documentation, runbooks, and handover materials.

Required Skills & Experience:
• 5+ years of Informatica PowerCenter experience - mappings, sessions, workflows, and parameterization
• 3+ years of hands-on dbt Core experience - model layering, macros, tests, incremental materializations
• Any number of years of Airflow experience - DAG authoring, task dependencies, and incorporation with scheduling tool

The Tier 2 Technician – Third Shift provides advanced technical support, maintenance, and monitoring for Company’s managed client environments during overnight hours.   • Follow established security, change-management, escalation, and service-management procedures, and protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of client systems and data.

Education & Experience

  • 2–4 years of experience in IT support, desktop support, managed services, or a related field.

  • MSP or multi-client environment experience preferred.
  • Overnight, on-call, or 24/7 operations experience preferred.

Technical Knowledge

  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Windows, Microsoft 365, and common business applications.

  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals and connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Experience with remote support and remote monitoring and management (RMM) tools.
  • Experience with ticketing systems and structured IT service processes.
  • Backup monitoring and troubleshooting experience preferred.

Core Competencies

Work Environment

    We're hiring a Senior Performance Creative to partner with our Creative Strategist and turn research, hooks, and loose briefs into polished static and short-form video ads for paid social. The role requires strong range across design and motion editing, including cutting raw shoot footage into finished assets. It also requires the brand fluency to stay on-brand at high volume, whether working from a one-pager or a full brand system, while pushing creative into fresh territory.

    Here’s what we expect from our Senior Motion & Graphic Designer.

—What You'll Do—

    Creative & Strategic Judgment

    • A strong eye for what "good" looks like in modern performance advertising — thumb-stopping, polished, and effective, not just pretty

    • High attention to detail — typos, brand misapplications, and spec errors don't make it to client review

    Working Style

—What success looks like—

jobs.title: Principal Mini Program Architect OleOle | Platform Architecture & Engineering
jobs.excerpt: We’re not looking for beginners if you don’t have the skill set please do not send your résumé As Principal Mini Program Architect, you will own the technical architecture and engineering direction of OleOle’s Mini Program platform.
jobs.description:
We’re not looking for beginners if you don’t have the skill set please do not send your résumé

As Principal Mini Program Architect, you will own the technical architecture and engineering direction of OleOle’s Mini Program platform.

You will design the infrastructure, developer frameworks, APIs, security architecture, and runtime environment that allow third-party Mini Programs to be created, deployed, discovered, and operated securely at global scale.

This is a hands-on architecture and engineering position, not simply a management role.

You will work closely with OleOle’s frontend, backend, identity, payments, security, and infrastructure engineers to establish a unified technical architecture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect the Mini Program runtime, including sandboxed execution, resource management, application lifecycle, and secure integration with the OleOle host platform.
  • Design the Mini Program SDK, APIs, developer tooling, and application frameworks.
  • Establish developer workflows for application creation, testing, submission, review, publishing, deployment, versioning, and updates.
  • Design secure authentication, authorization, identity, and permissions between Mini Programs and the OleOle platform.
  • Integrate Mini Programs with OleOle’s existing identity and Wallet ID architecture, enabling a consistent user identity across applications.
  • Architect integration with OleOle’s payments infrastructure to support transactions, commerce, and financial services within Mini Programs.
  • Define standards for performance, reliability, scalability, isolation, and security.
  • Design application discovery, distribution, and lifecycle management.
  • Establish technical standards, documentation, and development practices for external developers.
  • Make practical architectural decisions that support rapid initial delivery without compromising the platform’s ability to scale.
  • Work directly with engineering teams to implement and validate the architecture.

The successful candidate will have substantial ownership of one of OleOle’s most important long-term technology initiatives.

Skills & Engineering Requirements

Core Technical Expertise

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial experience designing complex platforms or developer ecosystems.
  • Strong expertise in TypeScript, JavaScript, and modern web application architectures.
  • Deep understanding of browser runtimes, WebViews, JavaScript execution environments, and application sandboxing.
  • Experience designing SDKs, APIs, developer platforms, and extensible application frameworks.
  • Strong knowledge of microservices, distributed systems, backend infrastructure, and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience with secure authentication and authorization, including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, token-based authentication, and permissions management.
  • Knowledge of API security, application isolation, content security policies, and third-party code execution risks.
  • Experience designing high-scale cloud-native systems, preferably using AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, and modern CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of application performance, caching, monitoring, observability, and reliability engineering.
  • Ability to translate platform architecture into production-quality engineering implementations.

Highly Valuable Experience

  • Direct experience with WeChat Mini Programs, Alipay Mini Programs, or similar embedded application ecosystems.
  • Experience building developer SDKs, plugin architectures, extensions, application marketplaces, or embedded app frameworks.
  • Familiarity with React, React Native, or comparable frontend frameworks.
  • Experience with mobile-to-web interoperability and cross-platform application delivery.
  • Knowledge of digital wallets, payment orchestration, transaction APIs, and financial platform integration.
  • Experience building developer portals, testing environments, application approval systems, and publishing pipelines.
  • Experience designing platforms that support large numbers of independent third-party developers.

What Matters Most

We are looking for an architect who understands how to build an application ecosystem, not simply an engineer who has developed individual applications.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise, practical engineering judgment, security awareness, and the ability to build foundational technology from the ground up.

Experience with existing Mini Program ecosystems is particularly valuable, but we will also consider outstanding platform architects who have built comparable developer ecosystems, SDKs, application runtimes, or extensible software platforms.

We value engineers who can make decisions, write code, solve difficult architectural problems, and deliver working systems.

Solutions not problems .

  • Creative problem solver who can courageously propose and support new ideas to our organization. Not interested in best practices, lets build something better!
  • Ability to adapt. An ideal candidate will welcome the opportunity to solve a broad range of problems using a wide array of technologies.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities and general growing pains of an early-stage technology company
  • An exceptional entrepreneurial judgment that fosters independence over micro-management
  • Understanding of football and international sports a huge plus

Deferred compensation

This opportunity is designed for entrepreneurial, startup-minded engineers who want to help build a significant global business. This is not free work. Compensation is agreed upon and deferred until funding is secured, at which point it transitions to a competitive, normalized salary plus equity and OleX token ownership. Our entire team, including the founder, operates under this arrangement. This position is intended for individuals who understand the risks of an early-stage startup, are comfortable with uncertain funding timelines, and are motivated by the opportunity to build something substantial while participating in its long-term ownership and success.

Ole Ole is located in beautiful Austin Texas, however, this role requires some travel we are privately held and rapidly growing!

What We’re Building

OleOle is building a global digital platform dedicated to football, bringing together social networking, messaging, live scores, content, commerce, and a new ecosystem of Mini Programs.

Our ambition is to create a platform serving 400 million football fans worldwide, with an ecosystem of 2 million professional football teams, brands, businesses, and developers creating Mini Programs that operate directly within OleOle.

Mini Programs are central to this vision.

Rather than requiring users to download separate applications, OleOle will enable businesses, football clubs, and independent developers to build lightweight, integrated applications that run within the OleOle ecosystem.

A football club could create a Mini Program for merchandise, memberships, ticketing, or exclusive fan experiences. A global brand could create interactive campaigns, product experiences, or customer services. Independent developers could build applications for commerce, entertainment, travel, utilities, and other services.

These Mini Programs will share a common foundation for identity, authentication, payments, permissions, discovery, and integration with the broader OleOle platform.

Our objective is not simply to introduce another application feature. We are building a developer ecosystem and application platform within OleOle, enabling millions of businesses and developers to create services that can reach a global audience without requiring users to leave the platform.

We are looking for an exceptional architect who can design the technical foundations of this ecosystem from the ground up.

OleOle — Where Fans Kick Off.

Senior Clinical Research Associate

Valencia, California – REMOTE FOR THE RIGHT CANDIDATE | WEST COAST BASED PREFERRED

Join Advanced Bionics as a Senior Clinical Research Associate and take a lead role in the operational execution of global medical device clinical studies from study start-up through close-out. You will manage complex investigative sites, drive study quality and performance, identify and mitigate operational risks, and serve as an experienced clinical operations resource to study teams while helping advance innovative hearing healthcare technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Independently lead the operational execution of assigned global clinical studies from site start-up through close-out in accordance with study protocols, ICH-GCP, ISO 14155, FDA regulations, and applicable international regulatory requirements.

  • Conduct site qualification, initiation, interim monitoring, and close-out visits (SQV, SIV, IMV, and COV) for complex or high-priority studies.

  • Lead site activation, investigator training, study device accountability, close-out planning, and other activities required to achieve study milestones.

  • Serve as the primary operational lead for assigned investigative sites, monitoring enrollment, site performance, protocol compliance, and data quality while proactively identifying and mitigating risks.

  • Independently resolve complex monitoring findings, protocol deviations, data queries, and site-performance issues while escalating significant risks with recommended solutions.

  • Maintain inspection-ready TMF/eTMF and investigator site documentation, support audits and regulatory inspections, and promote consistent application of clinical quality standards.

  • Partner with Clinical Trial Management, Data Management, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Medical Affairs, and external vendors while mentoring CRAs and supporting clinical operations process improvements.

More about you

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Nursing, Biomedical Engineering, or another related scientific discipline.

  • Minimum 5 years of clinical research experience, including at least 2 years of independent site monitoring.

  • Experience managing multiple clinical sites and working with CTMS, EDC, and eTMF systems.

  • Strong knowledge of ICH-GCP, ISO 14155, FDA regulations, clinical monitoring, site management, and data quality.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex studies, multiple priorities, operational risks, and site-performance challenges.

  • Strong organizational, communication, problem-solving, and time-management skills.

  • Ability to travel approximately 30–50% to study sites, conferences, and other study-related activities.

Preferred qualifications include: a Master's degree or equivalent; ACRP-CRA, ACRP-CP, or SOCRA CCRP certification; experience in Class III medical device clinical trials, global multicenter studies, FDA IDE/PMA or EU MDR clinical studies; experience mentoring junior CRAs or leading monitoring activities; and knowledge of Risk-Based Monitoring/RbQM.

Who we are

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking a high-impact, strategic seller to lead the go-to-market execution for our newest frontiers in Connected Equipment. As an Enterprise Specialist (Overlay), you will partner with our Account Executives (AEs) to build deep partnerships with our largest, most complex accounts. You aren't just selling a tool; you are pioneering GTM, ensuring our customers realize continuous value from new products as a part of the overall platform.

This specialist reports into the VP of Sales, EMEA and will be aligned by segment and product. AEs on the team are charged with accelerating the growth of one or more new product(s) and will be incentivized on quarterly product sales targets mapped to mainline sellers in the segment. Product Specialist sellers drive growth through strategic, high-value deal executing and enabling the segment overall to be successful.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’re meeting with a VP of Operations in waste management; the next, you’re diving into the logistics of a global food distributor. You seek to understand the "unit of value" for every customer.
  • You build genuine, high-stakes relationships: Our customers operate in "boots-on-the-ground" industries. They value earned trust and partners who understand their operational realities.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team Player: In an overlay role, your success is tied to the success of the broader account team. You lead through influence, not just authority.

In this role, you will:

  • Architect deals that align Samsara’s new products value with customer use cases to provide maximum value and return on investment
  • Co-generate new product pipeline with ADRs/AEs across high propensity to buy accounts
  • Drive strategy and pilot/trial success
  • Provide commercial insights and pricing benchmarks often for unique set of competitors in the market
  • Partner with GTM and Product to feed back insights and help shape roadmap
  • Build frameworks, assets and insights that scale across the sales org
  • Travel 20%+ to meet customers where they physically operate and to advance solutions and deals
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years in complex, full-cycle Enterprise sales.
  • Proven Track Record: Consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts with £500k+/€500k+ ARR transactions.
  • Deal Complexity: Demonstrated success navigating 6- and 7-figure deals involving multiple stakeholders (Legal, Procurement, InfoSec, and C-Suite).
  • Entrepreneurial Agility: Experience selling new products where the playbook is still being written.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working in a specialist/overlay co-selling with a mainline AE team.
  • Second language experience in French or German at business-level proficiency.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.
